Your page structure should show the categories, then have links to show the product choices for each category. Use a text caption to describe the features of each product near the product photo. Examples: Pet toys can use a rechargeable battery, or work without a battery. [choice 1: This Bouncy Ball uses a rechargeable battery to light up when it bounces. ] [choice 2: This Feeder Ball holds kibble that falls out one at a time as the ball is rolled around. No battery required.]

  

The guidelines for page Layout are based on these priories:

Your goal is to make the buyer's interaction easy, reducing friction and encouraging sales.



Universal Design: Comfortable for people who have common disabilities (alt text for visually impaired, clear layout and navigation for dyslexia, wide space around buttons for mobility impaired). Design must be static (no animations) and super-easy for anyone to navigate intuitively on any device. NO images sliding over text, NO text sliding over images, NO tiny faint gray text over white background, NO slide shows. See:

"If you buy products through these links, Careful Shopper may earn a sales commission at no extra cost to you. As an Amazon Associate, I may earn a commission on qualifying purchases. "

title: Senior US Tax Accountant & Financial Manager (Hospice & Healthcare)
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a high-caliber Philippine Licensed CPA, US Enrolled Agent (EA), or Senior US Tax Specialist to take full ownership of financial operations, global cash-flow analysis, and tax compliance for a growing portfolio of US healthcare and hospice entities, along with related commercial property holding companies.

In this role, you will lead complex multi-entity accounting in QuickBooks, maintain bank-ready financial records, manage global cash flow, and oversee complete federal and state tax filing processes. You will report directly to executive leadership to ensure our global financial presentation, balance sheets, and debt structures meet bank and credit committee underwriting standards.



Key Responsibilities

 US Federal & State Tax Management: Prepare, review, and manage federal (Form 1040, 1065, 1120/1120-S) and multi-state tax returns across our healthcare, hospice, and property entities, ensuring strict IRS compliance and relocation/multi-state tax planning.

 

Underwriting & Bank-Ready Financial Statements: Maintain precise, audit-ready financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and global cash-flow models to support commercial credit reviews, bank financing applications, and executive decision-making.

 

QuickBooks Administration & Cleanups: Direct chart of accounts setup, multi-entity account reconciliations, historical cleanups, and routine maintenance across QuickBooks Online and Desktop.

 

Healthcare & Hospice Operational Accounting: Manage granular expense tracking, operational budgets, revenue cycle workflows, and debt service tracking tailored to hospice and healthcare facility operations.

Qualifications & Requirements

 

Licensure / Credentials (Any of the following):

 Active Philippine Licensed CPA (PRC), OR

 Active US Enrolled Agent (EA) status, OR

 Passed US CPA Exam / Active US CPA License (Highly Preferred).

 

US Taxation & Underwriting Expertise: 3–5+ years of hands-on experience handling complex US federal/state returns, global cash-flow analysis, and tax compliance across multiple entities.



 Industry Focus: Direct prior experience in healthcare, hospice, medical practice, or commercial real estate accounting.

 QuickBooks Mastery: Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Desktop (QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification is a strong plus).

 

Technical Workspace Setup: High-speed internet with power backup, a dedicated quiet workspace, and strict adherence to handling confidential health and financial records.



How to Apply:



To apply, please submit your application with the following:



1. Updated Resume / CV detailing your direct experience with US tax filings, QuickBooks multi-entity management, and healthcare/hospice financial operations.



2. A brief summary highlighting:

 The specific US tax forms you have prepared (1040, 1065, 1120/1120-S).



 The number of healthcare, hospice, or property entities you have managed simultaneously.



3. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

title: Content Production VA | YouTube Production & AI Tools
description:
We are looking for a Production VA to help keep daily production organized, maintain quality, and make sure videos are ready on time.



You should take pride in your work, enjoy learning, and want to contribute to the team. We value people who follow through on tasks, speak up when something needs attention, and suggest practical ways to improve the work.



Your responsibilities



Generate scripts, voiceovers, and videos using our AI tools and internal systems.

Make basic video edits using CapCut or similar software.

Upload and schedule videos, prepare the required details, and follow our approval process.

Report problems early, help resolve them, and communicate clearly when you need support.

Share useful observations about video performance and suggest workflow improvements.



What we are looking for



Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new software quickly.

Basic video-editing experience and familiarity with AI tools.

Clear written and spoken English.

Attention to detail and the ability to meet deadlines without repeated reminders.

A practical approach to solving problems.

Willingness to take feedback, learn from mistakes, and improve.

A reliable computer and internet connection.

Full-time availability, with this being your only job once you start.



Bonus skills



Youtube automation, graphic design or content creation experience is a plus. This could include creating thumbnails, graphics, videos, or other digital content. These skills are helpful but are not required for the role.



How we work



We will provide instructions, examples, and feedback to help you learn our workflow. You are expected to take notes, ask questions when something is unclear, and become more independent as you gain experience.



This role includes repetitive daily work that requires focus and consistency. You should check your work carefully, communicate honestly about delays or mistakes, and understand how your tasks affect the rest of the team.



How to apply



Please send:

A short introduction explaining your relevant experience and why this role interests you.

One or two work samples, with a clear explanation of what you personally did.

A specific example of a problem you solved or a process you improved.

Your computer specifications, internet speed, current work commitments, and earliest start date.



Please write your application in your own words and avoid AI-written responses or generic templates.

title: Facebook Community Manager
description:
Facebook Community Manager



We’re an e-commerce brand looking for someone to help manage and grow our
 group.



The group currently has around 200 members. We want to build an active community where potential customers come for advice, share their experiences and get involved.



We need someone who can take ownership, put a plan together and keep things moving without needing daily instructions.



What you’ll be doing:



- Build a content plan with a clear weekly posting schedule.

- Create engaging posts, including questions, polls, tips, match-day discussions and member spotlights.

- Welcome new members, reply to comments and encourage conversations.

- Find ways to attract relevant new members and grow the group organically.

- Introduce our brand and products naturally through useful advice, behind-the-scenes content and honest answers.

- Track what’s working and improve the plan as we go.



The aim is to create a useful community while helping members get to know our brand and build trust over time. We don’t want a group filled with constant promotional posts.



**Who we’re looking for:**



- Experience managing and growing
 groups or online communities.

- Strong written English and a natural, friendly communication style.

- Someone proactive who brings ideas and follows through.

- An interest in football would be a big plus.



**To apply, please send:**



1. A short introduction and your rates.

2. Examples of communities you’ve managed and the results you achieved.

3. A brief outline of how you’d approach our first 30 days, including a few post ideas.



We’re looking for someone who can help build a community people actually want to be part of.

This is not an administrative or HR-only role. This position combines:

Full-cycle hiring & people management

Operational execution & workflow oversight

Pipeline visibility & cross-department coordination

title: Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor & AI Creative Producer
description:
Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor & AI Creative Producer



Competitor ad recreation • Long-form VSLs • AI UGC • AI doctors/experts • Cartoon ads • Swedish, Danish & English localization



Read this first



We are not hiring someone whose main goal is to make videos look cinematic or aesthetically pleasing.



We are hiring someone who understands that a paid ad has one job: stop the right person, hold their attention, build belief and make them take action.



You should be able to receive a competitor ad, a script or a rough concept and return a complete, conversion-ready creative. That includes reverse-engineering the reference, finding or generating every necessary visual, producing voiceovers, creating captions, editing the video and delivering finished variations for testing.



If you need us to prepare a folder containing every clip before you can begin, this role is not for you.



If you can independently turn a script or reference ad into a finished ad that feels native, credible and built to sell, keep reading.



Who we are



We are a growing direct-response DTC brand in the health and wellness space. Paid social and creative are central to our growth, and we test both short-form ads and long-form VSLs across Meta and other platforms.



We are building an ongoing creative operation rather than hiring a different freelancer for every project. The goal is to find an editor and AI creative producer who learns our products, customers, winning angles and performance data—and becomes more valuable with every batch we produce.



This starts with a lower, paid project volume so we can evaluate the fit on both sides. If your work performs and the collaboration runs smoothly, the volume, responsibility and compensation will increase. The long-term goal is a stable position with ownership over a large part of our creative pipeline.



What you will actually be doing



1. Reverse-engineering and recreating winning ads



We actively research ads that are working in other markets and for adjacent or competing products. You will often receive a reference ad and be asked to rebuild it for our product and market.



This is not blind copying. Your job is to identify why the original works and preserve those conversion-driving elements while replacing the brand, product, claims, language, visuals and market context.



You must be able to break down and recreate:



The hook and first three seconds



Script structure and sales psychology



Pacing, cuts and pattern interrupts



Visual sequence and shot selection



Demonstrations and mechanism explanations



Proof, testimonials and credibility elements



Captions, on-screen text and callouts



Voiceover style, energy and timing



Music, sound design and emotional shifts



Offer presentation and call to action



Some assignments will require a close, shot-by-shot recreation. Others will require you to preserve the underlying structure while producing an original execution for our brand.



You may receive only the reference ad, product information and a few brand assets. You are expected to solve the rest independently.



2. Localizing ads into Swedish, Danish and English



You will recreate and localize ads for Swedish-, Danish- and English-speaking markets.



Localization does not mean translating every sentence word for word. The finished ad must sound as if it was originally written and produced for that market.



You will be responsible for:



Adapting scripts, hooks and CTAs into natural market-specific language



Preserving the meaning, rhythm and persuasion of the original



Adjusting examples, currency, cultural references and terminology when necessary



Creating or sourcing suitable native-sounding voiceovers



Timing the edit around the localized voiceover rather than forcing a translation into the original timing



Producing accurate subtitles and on-screen text in each language



Flagging awkward or questionable wording before production



Native-level Swedish or Danish is a strong advantage. If you are not fluent, you must have a reliable localization workflow and be comfortable working with approved translations and feedback from native speakers.



3. Producing long-form VSLs



You must be comfortable editing sales videos from approximately 2 to 10+ minutes—not only 15-second social clips.



We provide the script or a proven reference. You turn it into a video that holds attention throughout the entire argument.



That includes:



Mapping a visual plan to every section of the script



Finding or creating enough visual variety to prevent retention from collapsing



Using cuts, zooms, graphics, captions and pattern interrupts intentionally



Visualizing problem and solution mechanisms clearly



Building emotional story sequences rather than placing random stock clips over narration



Introducing the product at the correct point in the story



Showing proof, demonstrations, testimonials, reviews and offer elements credibly



Creating visual callbacks and open loops



Maintaining consistent pacing across several minutes



Delivering different hooks or openings for the same proven body when requested



You need to understand that a long-form VSL cannot feel like a slideshow. Every shot must help explain, prove, intensify or move the story forward.



4. Sourcing footage independently



You will be responsible for finding the footage required by the script.



Sources may include:



Licensed stock libraries



Creator or UGC footage that is cleared for commercial use



Organic social content used as a research reference and then recreated appropriately



Product footage supplied by us



Screen recordings



Public-domain or properly licensed archival footage



AI-generated images and video



Custom graphics, animations and mechanism visualizations



You should know how to research visual references on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other platforms, identify the exact type of scene the script needs, and then source, license or recreate an appropriate version for commercial use.



You must not simply place random lifestyle clips over a voiceover. If the script says a woman wakes at 2:13 AM, presses the same point near her shoulder blade and opens her laptop, the visuals should communicate that exact moment as convincingly as possible.



5. Generating AI footage and complete AI ads



AI production is a core part of this role, not an occasional bonus.



You must already be able to generate usable commercial footage and know how to fix common AI problems through prompting, reference images, shot design, iteration, compositing, cleanup and upscaling.



Examples of what you may need to create:



Credible doctor, physiotherapist or expert-style presenters



UGC-style customers speaking naturally to camera



Product demonstrations that cannot be filmed practically



Medical or anatomical mechanism visualizations



Before-and-after scenarios without misleading viewers



Consistent characters appearing across multiple scenes



Story-driven scenes in homes, offices, clinics and everyday environments



AI product shots and controlled product placement



Animated explainer sequences



Cartoon and character-led ads



Talking avatars, lip-sync and multilingual versions



Visual metaphors for pain, pressure, stress, sleep or relief



Complete ads produced primarily or entirely with AI



The output cannot look like low-effort AI content. Characters, environments, clothing, product details, lighting and visual style should remain consistent. Motion must feel intentional, and obvious generation errors must be corrected before delivery.



6. Producing UGC, expert, cartoon and other ad formats



We test many formats. You should not be limited to one editing style.



You may be asked to produce:



Native UGC and testimonial-style ads



Doctor or expert advertorial videos



Founder or spokesperson videos



Podcast-style ads



Interview and street-interview concepts



Long-form personal discovery stories



Problem–mechanism–solution VSLs



Listicle and advertorial creatives



AI cartoon stories



Animated explainers



Product demonstration ads



Before-and-after narratives



Short hook-first ads



Static-to-video and image-led ads



Competitor recreations and new variations of existing winners



You should understand how the format changes the viewer's expectations. A native UGC ad should not feel like a polished television commercial, and an expert video should not feel like an obviously fake authority endorsement.



7. Creating captions, graphics, audio and final deliverables



You own the complete post-production process.



This includes:



Accurate subtitles with intentional emphasis



Clean, readable on-screen text for mobile viewers



Kinetic text and callouts where useful



Proper audio levels and voice cleanup



Music and sound design that support the emotional pacing



Colour correction across mixed footage



Removing unwanted text or branding when legally and technically appropriate



Product replacement, tracking and compositing where required



Correct aspect ratios, safe zones, frame rates and export settings



Organized project files and clear version naming



Multiple hooks, CTAs or format variations without rebuilding the entire ad inefficiently



What we need you to understand about direct response



You do not need to be the copywriter, but you must understand the strategy behind the script you are editing.



You should be able to identify:



The target customer and exact problem being called out



The mass desire the ad activates



The problem mechanism: why previous attempts have failed



The solution mechanism: why this approach may work differently



The awareness and sophistication level of the market



The promise, proof, objections and offer



The emotional turning point in the story



Which moments require visual proof rather than generic b-roll



Where retention is likely to drop



Why one hook attracts buyers while another only produces cheap clicks



We want an editor who can challenge a weak visual idea, flag a credibility problem and suggest a stronger way to communicate the same sales point.



Non-negotiable skills



Proven experience editing paid social ads designed to convert



Ability to reverse-engineer and recreate competitor ads accurately



Ability to work from a script or reference without being handed every asset



Strong visual research and independent footage sourcing



Real, current experience with AI image and AI video generation



Ability to maintain character and scene consistency across many AI shots



Ability to edit both short-form ads and long-form VSLs



Strong pacing, storytelling and retention instincts



High-quality subtitles, motion graphics, sound design and audio cleanup



Ability to follow a brief closely while still solving problems independently



Fast and reliable communication



Willingness to receive direct feedback and iterate quickly



Honest use of commercially cleared, licensed, supplied or appropriately generated assets



Ability to follow advertising, disclosure and platform rules: synthetic presenters must never be passed off as real doctors, customers or independent experts, and testimonials, credentials and results must never be fabricated



Ability to deliver organized source files when requested



Tools



You should be highly capable with professional editing software such as:



Adobe Premiere Pro



After Effects



DaVinci Resolve



CapCut Desktop or an equivalent professional workflow



You should also already use several tools in categories such as:



AI video: Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Higgsfield, Hailuo, Seedance or equivalent



AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Ideogram, Nano Banana or equivalent



Voice and lip-sync: ElevenLabs, HeyGen or equivalent



Cleanup and upscaling: Topaz, Magnific or equivalent



Audio restoration: Adobe Podcast, Descript or equivalent



Text and object removal, tracking and compositing tools



We care more about the quality and consistency of your output than the exact tools you use. However, “I am willing to learn AI” is not enough. You should already be producing AI-assisted ads now.



This role is probably not for you if…



You only edit with footage supplied by the client



Your portfolio is mainly cinematic montages, music videos or organic content with no sales objective



You can make a video look good but cannot explain why it should convert



You rely on random stock footage that does not match the script



You use one-click AI outputs without correcting obvious inconsistencies



You cannot recreate the pacing and visual logic of a reference ad



You only produce short-form videos and avoid long-form projects



You disappear for several days when something is unclear



You miss deadlines without warning



You are an agency planning to pass the work to an undisclosed junior editor



We want direct access to the person who will actually create the videos.



How the collaboration starts



The first stage is a paid trial period with a limited number of projects.



Initial assignments will mainly involve:



Recreating and localizing proven competitor ads



Producing Swedish, Danish or English variations



Editing new hooks onto proven ad bodies



Creating short-form ads from existing scripts



Producing selected long-form VSLs



We will evaluate:



How accurately you understand the reference



Whether you preserve what makes it persuasive



Your ability to source or generate visuals without hand-holding



Speed and communication



Attention to language, product details and brand consistency



How well your finished ads hold attention and convert



How you respond to feedback and improve across iterations



If the fit is strong, the workload and pay will increase. The long-term opportunity is a stable ongoing role with greater ownership, performance-based upside and room to grow into a senior creative or creative-lead position.



What you get



Consistent paid work with room to scale



Access to proven competitor references, scripts and performance feedback



Visibility into important metrics such as spend, hook rate, hold rate, CTR and CPA when available



Fast, direct feedback from a small team



Budget for approved tools or production resources when justified



Performance bonuses for creatives that become meaningful winners



The opportunity to help shape the creative system, not just execute isolated edits



A path toward a stable long-term role if the collaboration performs



How to apply



Please follow these instructions exactly. Applications that ignore them will not be reviewed.



Begin your application with the words: CREATIVE SELLS.



Then include the following:



1. Your portfolio



Send direct links to relevant work—not only a general showreel.



We specifically want to see:



At least one competitor ad recreation; send both the original reference and your version if possible



At least one long-form VSL of 3 minutes or longer



At least one AI-generated ad or scene sequence you produced yourself



At least one UGC-style paid ad



Any cartoon or animated direct-response ad you have made



Examples produced in Swedish, Danish or English, if available



2. A short breakdown of three projects



For three selected examples, explain in no more than three sentences each:



What the goal of the ad was



What you did to hold attention and build belief



Which parts you personally handled



Any results you are allowed to share, such as spend, CPA, ROAS, CTR, hook rate or retention



3. Your AI workflow



Tell us:



Which AI tools you use and what you use each one for



How you maintain the same character across multiple scenes

Instead, we will provide you with relevant opportunities, and your job will be to participate in these conversations naturally and appropriately.



What you'll do:

title: Appointment Setter + Closer
description:
Hi! We're looking for someone part-time to help us connect with U.S. business owners who may be looking for business funding.



We are a **new and growing company**, so we're looking for someone who would like to grow with us. We will take care of building the company brand, social media presence, and trust with potential clients, while your main focus will be finding and connecting with business owners who may need funding.



This is a remote position for approximately **20 hours per week**.



### What you'll be doing



Your main goal will be to find business owners who may need funding, reach out to them, understand what they're looking for, qualify them, and schedule an appointment.



You'll help with:



- Finding potential U.S. businesses to contact

- Finding the right owner or decision-maker

- Cold calling and reaching out to business owners

- Asking basic questions about their funding needs

- Qualifying interested prospects based on our criteria, such as approximately **600+ FICO**, revenue, time in business, funding needs, etc.

- Scheduling appointments

- Following up with interested business owners

- Confirming appointments and reducing no-shows

- Keeping notes and updating the CRM



We'll provide guidance, qualification criteria, and information about our process. We will also work on the marketing, social media, and brand side to help build trust and make your outreach easier over time.



### Do I need closing experience?



**No!**



We're primarily looking for someone who is good at prospecting, talking to business owners, and setting qualified appointments.



If you **do have experience closing business funding deals**, that's a big plus, and you'll have the opportunity to earn an additional bonus by closing the prospects you bring in.



### Compensation



**First month:** $250/month base  

**After a successful first month:** $300/month base



This is for approximately **20 hours per week**.



You'll also earn:



**+$5 for every qualified appointment that actually attends**



If you don't have closing experience, that's completely fine. Your responsibility ends with generating a qualified prospect and getting them to attend the appointment.



If you **have closing experience and close the deal yourself:**



**+$100 for each deal you personally close that successfully funds and generates revenue for the company.**



So there are two ways the position can work:



**Appointment Setter:**  

Base pay + **$5 per qualified attended appointment**



**Appointment Setter + Closer:**  

Base pay + **$5 per qualified attended appointment + $100 for each deal you personally close that successfully funds**



There is no limit on the number of performance bonuses you can earn.



### First Month Trial



The **first month will be a trial period for both of us**. Since we're a new company, we need to make sure that this position is producing real opportunities and that we're a good fit for each other.



We're not expecting perfection immediately, and there will naturally be a learning period. However, we do need to see consistent effort and, most importantly, **qualified appointments being generated**.



If after the first month there are no qualified appointments being produced despite the support and resources provided, unfortunately we may not be able to continue the position. We want to be transparent about this from the beginning rather than create unrealistic expectations.



On the other hand, if things are going well, we'd love to continue working together, increase the base to **$300/month**, and hopefully grow the role as the company grows.



### Who we're looking for



You don't necessarily need previous business-funding experience.



We're looking for someone who is:



- Comfortable cold calling U.S. businesses

- Confident speaking with business owners

- Able to find potential businesses and decision-makers

- Friendly and professional

- Persistent with follow-ups

- Organized and reliable

- Comfortable working independently

- Motivated to generate results



Experience with **appointment setting, lead generation, B2B sales, MCA, business loans, business funding, or closing** is a plus.



Most importantly, we're looking for someone proactive who can **find opportunities rather than simply wait for leads to be provided**.



If you're great at finding business owners, starting conversations, and turning those conversations into qualified appointments, we'd love to hear from you!



### To Apply



Please send a short introduction about yourself and answer the questions below. No need to write long answers just be honest and specific. Candidates who seem like a good fit will be invited to a **short interview (maximum 30 minutes).**



1. **Please tell me a little about yourself and your previous work experience.**



2. **Do you have experience with cold calling, appointment setting, lead generation, or sales?** If yes, please briefly explain what you did.



3. **Have you worked with U.S. businesses or business owners before?**



4. **Have you worked in business funding, MCA, business loans, financial services, or a similar industry?** This is a plus, but not required.



5. **Have you had to find your own prospects before, or were leads provided to you?** If you found your own prospects, briefly explain how you found them.



6. **Are you comfortable finding U.S. businesses and business owners to contact on your own?**



7. **Approximately how many cold calls have you made per day in previous roles, and how many appointments were you typically able to book?** If you don't have previous experience, that's okay — just say so.



8. **Do you have any closing experience?** If yes, what type of product or service did you sell, and were you personally responsible for closing the deal?



9. **Are you available approximately 20 hours per week and able to make calls during U.S. business hours?**



10. **Are you comfortable with the compensation and one-month trial period described in the job post?**



We're keeping the hiring process simple. If your experience looks like a potential fit, we'll invite you to a short call of **up to 30 minutes** to get to know you and ask a few additional questions.

title: Client Success Manager (CSM Role)

The Role



You will be the first person our new clients talk to after they sign with us. Your job is to onboard them into our systems, get them set up in Meta Ads Manager and GoHighLevel, and make sure they understand how everything works before we start running their campaigns.



You will take 1 to 2 onboarding calls per day. Each call lasts 30 to 60 minutes. Between calls, you will prepare onboarding documents, set up client accounts, configure GoHighLevel workflows, and coordinate with our team to make sure everything is ready before each call.



This is not a sales role. You are not selling anything. You are guiding clients through a technical setup process and making them feel confident that they are in good hands.



What You Will Do



Conduct 1 to 2 onboarding calls per day with new clients via Zoom. Walk them through the Meta Ads Manager setup process, including granting access, setting up the pixel, and configuring conversion tracking. Walk them through the GoHighLevel setup process, including granting access, importing our workflows, setting up calendars, configuring SMS and
 sequences, and connecting their phone numbers.



Prepare onboarding documents and checklists before each call so the client knows exactly what to expect and what to prepare. Follow up with clients after each call to confirm they have completed any remaining setup steps. Coordinate with our internal team via Slack to flag any technical issues, account access problems, or client concerns that need attention.



Track the status of every onboarding in a shared spreadsheet so the team knows where each client is in the process. Ensure every client is fully onboarded and ready for campaign launch within 3 to 5 business days of signing.



What We Are Looking For



Strong spoken English. You will be on video calls with clients daily, so clear communication is non-negotiable.



Experience with GoHighLevel. You should know how to navigate the platform, set up workflows, build pipelines, configure calendars, connect integrations, and troubleshoot basic issues. If you have worked inside GoHighLevel before, this is a big advantage.

title: Sales Operations Support Coordinator
description:
About the role



We are looking for a curious, dependable and highly organized Sales Operations Support Coordinator to help keep our sales team running smoothly.



This role combines sales administration, process compliance, product training coordination and recruitment support. You will be trusted to follow tasks through from beginning to end, ask thoughtful questions when something is unclear and ensure that no detail is overlooked.



This position is ideal for someone who takes genuine pride in their work. You should be willing to help wherever reasonably required and understand that both small administrative tasks and larger projects contribute to the success of the team.



As our business evolves, you will also be expected to learn new areas and take ownership of agreed projects and reasonable duties across the wider business. This is a varied role for someone who is adaptable, willing to contribute wherever needed and equally committed to routine responsibilities and larger projects.



Key responsibilities

* Sales processes and compliance

* Conduct regular checks to ensure the sales team follows established standard operating procedures.

* Maintain clear checklists and records of completed compliance checks.

* Identify missing steps, documentation or follow-ups and address them promptly.

* Follow each matter through to completion rather than assuming someone else will finish it.

* Provide concise updates to management on recurring issues and areas requiring attention.

* Suggest practical process improvements when gaps or inefficiencies are identified.



Product training and knowledge base

* Prepare and organize training materials for new products.

* Upload, structure and maintain content in Zoho Learn.

* Keep the company knowledge base accurate, current and easy to navigate.

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to obtain product files, specifications, images and other required information.

* Ensure relevant team members receive everything needed for product launches and sales training.

* Track outstanding information and follow up until it is received.

* Ask questions and confirm expectations whenever instructions or product information are unclear.



Recruitment support

* Prepare and post sales recruitment advertisements on SEEK and other approved channels.

* Review applications against agreed selection criteria.

* Conduct initial candidate screening by
, phone or video call.

* Maintain accurate candidate records and prepare clear shortlists for management.

* Coordinate interviews and communicate professionally with applicants.

* Handle applicant information responsibly and confidentially.



Daily roster and attendance support

* Prepare and monitor the team’s daily break roster.

* Check arrival times and attendance against agreed schedules.

* Record exceptions accurately and follow the appropriate escalation process.

* Communicate reminders professionally, consistently and fairly.

* Maintain accurate records so information can be easily reviewed when required.



Projects and evolving priorities

* Take ownership of new operational projects and change business priorities as assigned by management.

* Clarify the required outcome, scope, priority, deadline and stakeholders before commencing unfamiliar work.

* Turn instructions into a practical action plan with clear steps, responsibilities and due dates.

* Coordinate with internal team members, suppliers or other stakeholders as required.

* Track actions, dependencies and risks and provide clear progress updates.

* Ask questions and raise potential obstacles early rather than making assumptions or waiting until a deadline is missed.

* Carry projects through from initial instruction to completion, implementation and handover.

* Create or update the relevant SOP, checklist or supporting documentation when a project introduces a repeatable process.

* When project work competes with recurring responsibilities, confirm priorities with the manager so existing duties are not silently delayed or dropped.



General Operations: 

* Monitoring operations and reporting on performance.

* Helping implement new workflows, tools and processes.

* Troubleshooting operational issues.

* Coordinating across departments and with external suppliers.

* Analyzing information and preparing useful reports.

* Supporting onboarding and SOP training.



How we expect you to work



We are looking for someone who:

* Is naturally curious and wants to understand the reason behind a task.

* Asks sensible questions when unsure instead of guessing or remaining silent.

* Listens carefully and follows instructions accurately.

* Takes responsibility for tasks from commencement through to completion.

* Pays close attention to details and checks their work before submitting it.

* Is reliable, responsible and consistent—even when working independently.

* Follows established processes rather than creating unnecessary shortcuts.

* Completes all reasonable duties within the role instead of selecting only preferred tasks.

* Approaches small routine tasks with the same care as larger projects.

* Keeps files, trackers, messages and priorities organized.

* Communicates early if a deadline may be missed or assistance is required.

* Creates clear handover notes and ensures essential processes are covered before taking leave.

* Is honest, genuine and trustworthy in their communication and work.

* Accepts feedback positively and applies it to future work.

* Closes the loop by confirming when work has been completed.



Skills and experience

* At least two years’ experience in sales administration, operations support, recruitment coordination or a similar role.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

* Confidence in politely holding people accountable to agreed processes and deadlines.

* Ability to manage several recurring responsibilities without constant supervision.

* Experience maintaining SOPs, checklists, trackers or knowledge bases.

* Sound judgement when working with confidential recruitment and attendance information.

* Competence with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

* Experience coordinating or managing projects from initial brief through to completion.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving and time-management skills.

* Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and processes quickly.

* Ability to work independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate an issue.

* Experience identifying operational bottlenecks and recommending practical improvements.

* Experience with Zoho Learn, other Zoho applications, SEEK or an Australian business will be highly regarded but is not essential.



Working arrangements

* Location: Remote, Philippines

* Hours: Mondays to Fridays 9am-5.30pm

* Time zone: Australian Eastern Standard Time, including daylight-saving changes.

* Employment type: Full-time

* Salary: PHP 50,000 per month, plus 13th-month pay, paid leave and health-insurance benefits. 

* Start date: ASAP

* The successful candidate will require a reliable internet connection, a suitable home workspace and the ability to attend online meetings during the required working hours.



How to apply



Please submit:

* Your résumé.

* A short introduction explaining your relevant experience and why this role interests you.

* An example of a process, checklist, tracker or knowledge base you have maintained.

* An example of a task you managed from initial instruction through to completion.

* Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

* Your availability and notice period.



Please begin your application with the words “Sales Operations” so we know you have read the advertisement carefully.

title: Video Editor (Fast Turnaround / Simple Commentary Style)
description:
Job Type: Contract / Freelance (Ongoing)



Rate: $1.50 per video minute (Final length of the video)



Turnaround Time: Strict 12-hour deadline from the time raw footage is provided.



About the Role:

We are looking for a reliable, efficient video editor to handle a new, streamlined video editing tier for our channel. The content is primarily political/news commentary featuring a single speaker talking directly to the camera. We need clean, fast-paced edits delivered quickly.



Requirements & Style:

Simple & Clean: No heavy motion graphics or complex animations required.



Pacing: Tighten up the commentary. Cut out long breaths, pauses, "ums," and dead air to keep the viewer engaged.

title: Remote Lettings and Property Management Assistant
description:
Celestial Globe North London (CGNL) is looking for a Lettings and Property Management Assistant to support our team while working from home. You will help manage enquiries, advertise properties, support tenants through move in and day to day tenancy matters, and keep landlords updated. The role requires clear communication, careful follow up and good knowledge of UK lettings and property management.

Working arrangement  Remote, working UK hours (9:00 am to 6:00 pm).

Key responsibilities

• Prepare and publish accurate property listings on Zoopla and Rightmove, including descriptions, photographs, floor plans and key property details; check listings regularly and update availability, prices and status when instructed.

• Respond promptly to prospective tenant enquiries, arrange viewings with the relevant colleagues, follow up with applicants and help progress offers and tenancy paperwork.

• Coordinate the move in process, including referencing updates, tenancy documents, deposit administration, inventory and check in bookings, keys and clear instructions for new tenants.

• Help tenants after move in with practical questions, including how to register council tax, gas, electricity, water and broadband accounts; liaise with suppliers or the council where needed and follow up until issues are resolved.

• Log maintenance requests, gather the information and photographs needed, obtain quotes or arrange contractors as appropriate, schedule access, track progress and confirm completion with tenants and landlords.

• Keep landlords and tenants informed about repairs, delays, costs and next steps; flag urgent issues promptly to the property manager.

• Arrange check outs, inventories and end of tenancy cleaning; help gather evidence for proposed deposit deductions and communicate the outcome clearly.

• Track tenancy dates and assist with renewals, notices and other routine tenancy administration.

• Help arrange gas safety checks, EPCs, electrical and other required property documents or licensing where applicable, and keep records and reminders up to date.

• Assist with rent and client account administration, including checking payment records, following up on arrears, preparing information for landlord statements and escalating discrepancies.

• Maintain accurate property, landlord, tenant and contractor records; communicate with councils, utility providers, managing agents and freeholders when required; attend regular team meetings and report on open tasks.

What we are looking for

• Previous UK lettings or property management experience is essential, with a practical understanding of tenancy administration and tenant support.

• Confident written and spoken English, with a friendly and professional approach to tenants, landlords, applicants and contractors. Mandarin is an advantage.

• Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several cases, keep clear records and follow tasks through to completion.

• Comfortable using
, spreadsheets, property databases and online listing platforms; experience with Zoopla and Rightmove is useful.

• Able to work independently from home during UK working hours, communicate proactively with the team and recognise when an issue needs to be escalated.

How to apply

Please send your CV and a short cover letter to 
 with the subject line “Remote Lettings and Property Management Assistant – Your Name”. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

CGNL is an equal opportunity employer. Please tell us if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

We’re looking for someone who understands storytelling, advertising, editing, and AI production and knows how to turn those skills into creative that gets attention and drives results.

• Writing and scripting

• Creating strong hooks and concepts

• Direct response advertising

• Visual storytelling

• Pacing, structure, and retention

• Character and product consistency

• AI video and image generation

• Editing and post production

• Realistic and stylized AI content

We care about the output, not the tool stack.



THE STANDARD



We expect you to create realistic AI content that can pass as real footage, including believable people, products, environments, and movement.



That means:



• Consistent faces and characters

• Natural hands and movement

• Consistent products across shots

• Realistic environments and lighting

• Strong editing and pacing

• Minimal AI artifacts



You should also be comfortable creating stylized AI work such as 3D, animation, surreal concepts, cinematic sequences, transformations, and other AI first visuals.



Most importantly, you need to understand that good creative is more than good looking footage.



You need to understand why an ad works.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You’re a strong fit if you:



• Have experience creating ads or performance focused content

• Can develop concepts, not just execute prompts

• Can write scripts and create strong hooks

• Can edit independently

• Understand pacing, retention, and direct response

• Can troubleshoot AI generations and find solutions

• Have strong creative judgment

• Move quickly without sacrificing quality

• Take ownership of your work

• Always look for ways to improve the creative



DO NOT APPLY IF



• Your portfolio is mostly raw AI generations

• You only know how to prompt

• You need detailed instructions for every edit

• You don’t understand advertising or direct response

• You’re looking for a low pressure role where you can coast



This is not a beginner AI role.



WHAT YOU GET



• $1,500 to $3,000/month base, depending on experience and performance on the paid test

• Performance bonuses

• Full time remote role

• Real creatives running on serious ad spend

• Access to actual performance data

• Collaboration with Creative Strategists, editors, designers, and marketers

• Freedom to experiment with new tools and workflows

• Fast feedback loops

• Opportunity to take on more ownership as Luma’s AI creative capabilities grow



HIRING PROCESS



Application → Portfolio Review → Paid Test → Interview Call → Paid One Week Trial → Offer



The qualification test is paid whether or not we move forward.



We care more about what you can actually produce than how well you interview.



HOW TO APPLY



Complete the application form:







Your portfolio matters more than your resume.



If you can turn an idea into creative that makes people stop, watch, and take action, we want to see your work.

title: Business Development & Growth Specialist
description:
About Glow Up Hub

Glow Up Hub is an AI platform for beauty salon owners. Owners upload their own policies and procedures, and their staff get instant, accurate answers from the platform instead of texting the boss. We are a small, founder-led team getting ready to launch.



The role

Your goal is to get as many salons signed up as possible, by any ethical route that works. That includes everyday salons who sign up on their own/ low touch point, larger accounts (franchises and chains, salon groups with three or more locations, top tier accounts), and sales driven by influencers, beauty coaches, affiliates and referral partners, plus media and PR outreach and award entries, which are a main part of the role. All your communication is written, by
 and message, with no phone calls. You will be measured on paying salons signed up through your channels with bonuses/ pay increases to be determined after an agreed upon amount of time.



What you will do

Your work falls into six areas: everyday salons, larger accounts, influencers, beauty coaches and affiliates, referrals and partnerships, media, PR and awards, and reporting.





Everyday salons (low touch/ no touch signups),



Find independent salon owners across Australia and New Zealand, and message them with a clear reason to try Glow Up Hub and a link to sign up. Getting stand alone salons signing up will be your main focus initially

Join salon owner groups and communities, and turn useful conversations into signups

Follow up with people who showed interest or started signing up but did not finish, using lists we share

Reply personally to warm leads and interested salon owners from social, ads and groups, so no interest goes cold

Test new channels and report which ones bring in paying salons at the lowest effort





Larger accounts (top tier and enterprise),



Build target lists of franchises and chains, salon groups with three or more locations, and large salons likely to suit the top tier. This will be further into your role once we have a certain amount of salons already signed up

Reach out by
, LinkedIn and Instagram, and follow up until you get an answer (within reason)

Arrange demos with the founders by message, with notes on each prospect including their pain points

Support larger deals with proposals, follow-ups and answers to common objections





Influencers, beauty coaches and affiliates,



Find and approach beauty coaches, salon coaches, beauty educators, industry creators and salon owners with an engaged audience

Build our affiliate program from scratch and manage it, including tracking links, payouts and the information partners need to promote us

Onboard new affiliates and partners with a welcome message, their tracking link and the assets they need

Check in with partners regularly, and follow up with any who go quiet

Brief influencers and track what each one brings in with reports





Referrals and partnerships,



Build and run a referral program from scratch for existing salons





Media, PR and awards,



Build and maintain a media list of trade press, small business and startup outlets, mainstream business media, podcasts and newsletters that reach salon owners

Send our pitches, using the story angles and drafts we provide, and write new pitches for news such as launches, milestones and customer results

Follow up until you get a reply, and pass any interview or feature request to the founders straight away

Find and enter relevant awards, such as beauty, small business, startup and technology awards, and write the entries using the information we provide

Pursue speaking, podcast and newsletter opportunities where salon owners are listening

Track every outlet, pitch, award and response in the CRM, including award deadlines





Reporting,



Keep a simple CRM of every prospect, partner and affiliate, and what stage they are at

Send a short weekly report: outreach sent, replies, meetings booked, signups from each channel, and what to try next



What success looks like

We will agree signup targets together once we launch. Until then, here is what we expect in your first three months.



Month 1: finish training, build your first target lists and start outreach

Month 2: launch the affiliate and referral programs and begin media and award outreach

Month 3: have partners and channels bringing in paying salons, and tell us what is working so we can set targets



How the role works

You report to Laura, our CEO, and work closely with Kirsty, our CMO, on influencer and affiliate campaigns.



The founders run any calls, demos and negotiation on larger deals, and you arrange them in writing and prepare the notes

Partner terms, commission rates and discounts are agreed with the founders before you offer them

You use our own tools, such as the CRM and Klaviyo, through role-based permissions

We pay for the tools you need

Everything you send to a prospect or partner is approved first for the first few weeks





What we are looking for

The essentials are proven B2B outreach, persistence, and strong written English.



Must have



Experience in B2B sales, business development or partnerships, ideally selling software or services to small businesses

Experience writing pitches and press outreach, such as to journalists, podcasts or award panels, with examples

Strong written English with a warm, professional tone for Australian business owners

A track record of cold and warm outreach that led to booked meetings or signed deals, with examples

Organised and persistent, with a habit of following up and keeping a CRM up to date

Overlap with Melbourne business hours (AEST/AEDT) for at least a few hours a day



Nice to have



Experience running affiliate, referral or influencer programs

Experience in beauty, wellness or salon software





What this role is not

This is a growth and partnerships role, not a call centre or a support desk.



You will not make or take phone calls, as all communication is written

You will not set pricing, discounts or commission rates without approval

You will not promise features that are not built yet

You will not handle customer support or onboarding



Terms

This is a remote, part-time role to start, paid hourly and measured on paying salons signed up through your channels.



Hours: part-time to start, with room to grow 

Rate: [hourly rate to confirm, paid either weekly monthly]

Trial: four weeks paid, with a review at the end

Location: remote / work from home. We are located in Melbourne, Australia

Confidentiality: you will sign a confidentiality agreement, as you will see unreleased product

Ownership: all lists, files and accounts you work on belong to Glow Up Hub



What you get

You get paid training up front and a real chance to grow into a full time role.



Paid training at the start, covering the product, our scripts and how we work

The opportunity to move to full time as the business grows

Paid trial task

Shortlisted applicants complete one paid task, so we can see how you prospect and write before we d
. It should take about three to four hours, paid at your stated rate.



Build a list of 15 salon groups, beauty coaches, educators or industry creators in Australia who could bring us customers, with a link and a one line reason for each

Write a short first message for one of them, and a follow-up message for if they do not reply

Suggest three ways we could partner with them, such as an affiliate offer or a referral deal

List five media outlets, podcasts or awards in the beauty or small business space that suit us, and write a short pitch for one of them

We will supply a one page summary of the product to work from.



How to apply

Send us a short message and examples of your outreach or sales results. Please include:



A few lines on your experience in B2B sales, business development or partnerships and how your experience could work within this business

One or two examples of outreach you wrote and the result it got

Any experience with affiliate, referral or influencer programs

Your hourly rate and your weekly availability including overlap with Melbourne hours

title: Amazon FBA - Online Arbitrage / Wholesale Assistant
description:
Remote Amazon Sourcing & Operations Assistant

Remote | Part-Time or Full-Time | Some UK Hours Required



Who We Are

We run a growing UK Amazon seller business with a strong track record and an expanding product range, spanning Online Arbitrage (OA) and wholesale. Our sourcing is methodical and driven by data, and we're building a skilled, dependable remote team. If you're an experienced Amazon professional looking for a role with room to progress, we'd like to hear from you.



About the Role

You'll find profitable products to resell on Amazon, working to clear, firm sourcing criteria, and support the daily running of the business, from inventory and shipments to supplier follow-ups and customer queries. It's a role with real responsibility, suited to someone who takes ownership of their work and keeps their standards high.



What You'll Be Doing

  Sourcing and Listings

- Finding profitable OA and wholesale opportunities using Keepa, SellerAMP and other approved tools

- Reviewing sales rank history, pricing trends, Buy Box activity and competitor levels

- Checking ROI, estimated monthly sales and competition against our criteria

- Logging each lead in our internal tracker with full supporting data

- Reaching the daily lead target agreed with the team

- Adjusting prices on live products as needed

   Customer and Account Support

- Responding to customer
s

- Reviewing and claiming reimbursements

- Maintaining prep sheets

- Following up with suppliers on outstanding invoices

   Inventory and Shipments

- Keeping track of stock levels

- Setting up and creating shipments

   Team Communication

- Giving team leads clear, timely updates on findings and any issues

- Keeping on top of Amazon policy changes that affect sourcing



What You'll Need

- Proven hands-on experience with SellerAMP and Keepa

- Previous experience working with Amazon FBA and Seller Central

- A demonstrable record of sourcing profitable OA and/or wholesale products

- Solid understanding of Buy Box mechanics, and of how IP complaints and hazmat flags can rule out a lead

- Excellent written English for customer correspondence

- Strong organisational skills and confidence with Google Sheets or Excel

- Dependable internet and your own laptop or PC that runs browser extensions smoothly

- Ability to cover some UK working hours

Bonus skills: Tactical Arbitrage, BrickSeek or similar tools; knowledge of ungating and restricted categories; experience following SOPs within a VA team.



*Two-Week Probation*

Every new team member starts with a two-week probation period, during which we'll look at:

- How accurate and well-documented your leads are against our criteria

- Whether you consistently hit your daily output

- How clearly and promptly you communicate

- Your reliability and attention to detail

- Team leads will give you feedback along the way, and your place in the role is confirmed once you complete the probation successfully.



** Zero Tolerance Lead Policy! **

We operate a strict zero tolerance policy on lead integrity. Every lead you submit must be one you found yourself using approved methods. Using leads from shared lists, paid lead groups,
 groups or any third-party lead service is strictly forbidden and will result in immediate termination. We carry out verification checks, and any lead found on a publicly shared list will be flagged.



What You'll Get

- Competitive pay based on your experience and results (to be discussed at interview)

- A flexible, fully remote working arrangement

- Clear expectations and regular feedback

- Genuine opportunities to progress

- Bonuses linked to consistent, high-quality lead submissions

- A stable, long-term role within a professional team



The Person We're After

You have a solid background in Amazon sourcing and operations, and you're also a strong fit for how we work:

- Experienced: a proven track record with Amazon sourcing and operations

- Meticulous: in sourcing, small errors can be expensive

- Self-driven: you meet your daily targets without needing close supervision

- Honest and open in everything you do

- Dependable: you show up consistently, hit deadlines and communicate proactively

- Ambitious: you want to grow with the business



Please don't apply if you:

- Use, or plan to use, shared lead lists or lead groups

- Aren't willing to complete the two-week probation

- Can't commit to consistent daily output

- Aren't comfortable following strict sourcing criteria and SOPs

- Lack hands-on experience with Keepa and SellerAMP



How to Apply

To show you've read this far, add "Orange" to your application title. 

Then send us:

- A short introduction covering you and your background

- Your experience with Amazon FBA, Keepa and SellerAMP (how long you've used them, and whether you'd rate yourself intermediate or advanced)

- Your availability (hours per day, days per week, and the UK hours you can cover)

- Your expected pay rate or range

- An example of a sourcing decision you've made, with your reasoning

- Three leads you sourced in the past 7 days, each including the ASIN, source store/URL, buy cost, Amazon selling price, estimated ROI, and a Keepa screenshot or link (Only UK Amazon/Leads)

- A video of no more than 60 seconds telling us why you'd be a great fit for this role (a link is fine, for example Loom, Google Drive or an unlisted YouTube video, as long as we can view it without requesting access)



We can't review applications that are missing any of the above, and videos longer than 60 seconds may not be watched in full.



This is a remote position. Serious applicants only.



Many thanks for your time and we look forward to seeing your Applications!

title: FBA Manager
description:
The Role

As our Amazon FBA Manager, you will be the captain of our Amazon storefront. You will balance daily operational logistics with long-term growth strategies to maximize revenue, maintain healthy profit margins, and protect our account standing. You will treat this channel as your own business, driving decision-making from inventory forecasting to PPC bid management.



Key Responsibilities

Listing Optimization (SEO): Create, update, and optimize product listings using competitive keyword research to maximize conversion rates. Manage A+ Content, storefront design, and backend search terms.



Inventory & Supply Chain: Forecast demand, track stock levels, and coordinate with suppliers/3PLs to ensure seamless fulfillment into Amazon centers. Prevent stockouts while actively avoiding long-term storage fees.



PPC & Promotions: Design, execute, and monitor Amazon Sponsored Ads (Products, Brands, Display). Adjust bidding strategies to maintain a profitable ACoS. Plan and execute promotions for Prime Day, Q4, and other seasonal events.



Account Health: Monitor Seller Central daily for policy warnings, stranded inventory, and listing suppressions. Escalate and resolve support cases, manage customer reviews, and ensure strict compliance with Amazon’s Terms of Service.



Market Intelligence: Analyze market trends, track competitor pricing, and identify profitable opportunities for new product variations or line extensions.



What We’re Looking For

Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA accounts (Seller Central) with a proven track record of scaling revenue.

Analytical Skills: Strong financial acumen with the ability to interpret sales metrics, calculate landed costs, and track contribution margins.

Tool Mastery: Proficiency with industry-standard Amazon software such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Keepa, or SellerBoard.

Ad Strategy: Deep understanding of Amazon PPC strategies and bid management.

Problem Solver: You know how to navigate Amazon's complex ticketing system and aren't afraid to push for resolutions.



We offer performance-based increase and HMO, as part of our many perks and benefits.

title: Experienced Loan Processor / Broker Support – Australian Mortgage Broking
description:
We’re a growing Australian finance broking business looking for an experienced Loan Processor / Broker Support superstar to join our team.



This role will start part-time, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time position for the right person.



We’re not looking for someone to simply tick off tasks or wait to be told what to do.



We’re looking for someone who can take ownership of a loan application, understand where it’s at, know what needs to happen next and see it through from start to finish.



If you’ve worked in Australian mortgage broking before and enjoy keeping applications moving, chasing things up, staying organised and helping create a great experience for clients, this could be a great fit.



What the role looks like



You’ll work closely with our director / head broker and take charge of the processing side of each application.



That means helping manage files from the initial fact find and document collection all the way through to application, approval and settlement.



Your day-to-day will include:



Reviewing client fact finds and checking what’s missing



Following up clients for outstanding documents



Preparing and packaging loan applications



Data entry into aggregator and lender systems



Preparing Statements of Credit Assistance and other compliance documents



Ordering valuations



Assisting with servicing calculations where required



Lodging applications



Liaising with lenders, BDMs and credit teams



Following up applications and outstanding conditions



Keeping clients updated along the way



Managing conditional approval requirements



Following applications through to formal approval



Assisting with loan documents and settlement requirements



Preparing and following up discharge authorities



Keeping application notes and pipeline records up to date



Making sure nothing falls through the cracks



Most importantly, we want someone who can look at an application and think:



“What do I need to do next to get this settled?”



rather than:



“What task should I wait for next?”



You’ll probably love this role if…



You’ve already worked in Australian mortgage broking



You enjoy taking ownership of applications



You’re naturally organised



You like following things through to completion



You’re comfortable dealing with lenders and clients



You notice things before they become problems



You don’t need to be chased to follow something up



You’re happy working independently but know when to ask questions



You take pride in keeping files tidy and applications moving



You like being part of a small team where your work actually makes a difference



Systems experience



Experience with any of the following would be a big advantage:



-Simpology

-LoanApp

-NextGen

-ApplyOnline

-Infynity (Prefferable)

-Middle (Prefferable)

-Australian lender portals

-Microsoft Outlook / Office 365

-Electronic signing and document management systems



You definitely don’t need to know every system listed above, but previous Australian mortgage broking experience is important.



About us



We’re a growing finance broking business based in Australia.



We help clients with:



-Home loans

-Refinancing

-Investment lending

-Construction loans

-First-home buyers

-Debt consolidation

-Personal and asset finance

-Business and commercial lending



We’re a small and growing team, so you won’t just be another number. We’re looking for someone we can trust, work closely with and hopefully keep around for the long term.



The goal is for this person to become a key part of the business and someone who genuinely helps manage and drive the loan pipeline.



Role details



Position: Loan Processor / Broker Support

Location: Remote – Philippines

Hours: Part-time initially

Days: Monday to Friday

Future opportunity: Potential to move into a full-time position



There is some flexibility around hours for the right person, although availability during Australian business hours will be important.



How to apply

We’d love to hear a little about you rather than just receiving a generic CV.



Please include:



How long you’ve worked in Australian mortgage broking.



What your previous mortgage processing role involved.



Which systems you’ve used.



Which Australian lenders you’ve regularly dealt with.



Whether you’ve personally managed applications from start to settlement.



Roughly how many active applications you’ve managed at one time.



Your preferred working hours.



Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary.



One thing you enjoy about mortgage processing.



One example of a difficult application you helped get across the line.



And just to make sure you’ve read this far, please start your application with:



“I love getting loans settled.”



Bonus points if you can tell us why. 😄

title: Senior Construction Estimator (Buildxact)
description:
Senior Construction Estimator (Buildxact)

High-End Residential Projects (Project-Based / Remote)

 

ABOUT THE COMPANY

We are a Brisbane-based design and construct builder specialising in high-end residential homes. Our projects are detailed, design-driven and require a high level of accuracy, coordination and professionalism.

We operate with structured systems, clear processes and a strong focus on quality. We are seeking an experienced estimator who can integrate into our workflow and deliver precise, reliable outcomes.

 

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly experienced Construction Estimator with advanced Buildxact capability to support our team on a per-project basis.

You must be confident working independently, interpreting drawings, and producing accurate, buildable costings and construction schedules aligned with Australian standards.

You will be responsible for taking projects from concept or working drawings through to a fully built-out estimate, construction program and procurement setup within Buildxact.

This is a project-based engagement with ongoing work available for the right candidate.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Estimating

• Prepare detailed and accurate cost estimates using Buildxact and based on Brisbane/Australian Material, labour and supply rates

• Interpret architectural drawings, engineering and specifications

• Build full cost breakdowns including labour, materials, preliminaries, and allowances (PC/PS)

• Apply appropriate markups and ensure alignment with company pricing structure

• Identify missing scope, risks, and cost gaps early

cost planning and market pricing

• Develop and maintain accurate cost allowances based on Brisbane market rates

• Validate supplier and subcontractor pricing against current market conditions

• Ensure all estimates reflect realistic labour, material, and trade costs

• Adjust pricing based on specification level and project complexity

• Provide commercial input and recommendations, not just follow instructions 

Buildxact management

• Set up and structure projects correctly within Buildxact

• Create well-organised cost categories and coding

• Ensure estimates are clean, logical and easy to review buildxact recipes and systems

• Build and maintain structured Buildxact recipes for all major trade scopes

• Break down recipes into labour, materials and subcontract components

• Apply correct quantities, productivity rates and wastage factors

• Update recipes based on real supplier and subcontractor pricing

• Ensure consistency and accuracy across all estimates using standardised systems construction Scheduling

• Develop detailed construction schedules within Buildxact

• Sequence trades correctly based on Australian residential construction practices

• Allow for realistic durations, lead times, and dependencies 

Procurement and purchasing

• Manage procurement process from estimate to construction readiness

• Prepare and issue RFQs to suppliers and subcontractors

• Clearly define scope when requesting pricing to avoid gaps

• Analyse and compare quotes, providing recommendations

• Create and issue purchase orders within Buildxact

• Align procurement with budget and construction program coordination

• Communicate clearly with our internal team regarding assumptions, gaps, and risks

• Flag discrepancies between drawings, specifications, and pricing

• Work efficiently to meet agreed timeframes

 

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

• Proven experience as a construction estimator (minimum 3–5+ years)

• Advanced experience using Buildxact (essential)

• Strong understanding of construction costs in Brisbane or similar Australian markets

• Strong experience using Buildxact (this is essential)

• Experience estimating residential construction projects (high-end preferred)

• Ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings

• Strong understanding of construction sequencing and trade scopes

• Experience creating construction schedules

• Experience with procurement, RFQs and purchase orders

• High attention to detail and accuracy

• Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)

• Ability to work independently without constant supervision

 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

• Experience with Australian construction standards and terminology

• Experience working with builders or design and construct companies

• Understanding of PC and PS allowances

• Familiarity with take-offs and quantity estimation

 

ENGAGEMENT STRUCTURE

• Project-based work (not full-time employment)

• Paid per project or agreed milestone basis

• Ongoing pipeline of work for the right candidate

• Flexible working hours, but must meet agreed deadlines

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Accurate estimates with minimal revisions

• Clear, well-structured Buildxact files

• Realistic and buildable construction schedules

• Proactive identification of risks and missing scope

• Reliable delivery within agreed timeframes

 

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS (important)

To be considered, you must include the following:

1. A summary of your Buildxact experience 

2. Examples of projects you have estimated (residential preferred) 

3. Screenshots or sample outputs from Buildxact (if available) 

4. Your typical turnaround time for a full estimate 

5. Your proposed rate (per project or hourly) 

Applications without this information will not be considered.
