title: Senior Paid Media Strategist
description:
Linc Digital is a performance-driven marketing agency based in Perth, Australia. We manage SEO, Paid Media, and Web projects for Australian and international clients across automotive, construction, home services, professional services, and retail.



We are hiring a Senior Paid Media Strategist to own a portfolio of paid advertising accounts end-to end, primarily on Google Ads and Meta Ads. You will collaborate with our Paid Media Team Lead (who focuses on high-spend, high-touch accounts) on cross-account strategy, but your accounts are yours to run.



THE ROLE

You will own day-to-day strategy, execution, and optimisation across a portfolio of paid advertising accounts. You are the strategist for every account you touch: diagnosing performance issues, making optimisation calls, recommending budget shifts backed by data, and escalating risks early with clear reasoning and recommended actions. This means you are not waiting for direction. If a campaign is underperforming, you diagnose it and bring the action plan. If creative is fatiguing, you flag it and request a refresh. If traffic is not converting, you review the landing page and recommend changes. You think commercially about every dollar spent.



This is a long-term opportunity for the right person, with a clear path to increased hours and responsibility as the agency grows.



Core Responsibilities

- Campaign Strategy, Management & Optimisation

- Manage Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns across multiple client accounts simultaneously.

- Monitor daily performance and optimise for CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPC, and conversion rate.

- Structure and execute testing plans (creative, audiences, bidding strategies, placements).

- Identify scaling opportunities and recommend budget adjustments with supporting data.

- Understand how to reallocate spend based on efficiency (CPA) and real-world factors (e.g. stock availability, seasonal demand, offer changes).

- Proactively flag underperforming campaigns early with clear context, root-cause analysis, and recommended actions.  

- Recognise creative fatigue signals (frequency, CTR decline, rising CPM) and proactively initiate creative refresh requests with clear direction for the design team.



Conversion Tracking & Technical Ownership

- Own conversion tracking end-to-end. This is a core requirement, not a nice-to-have. You must be confident with GA4, GTM, 

- Enhanced Conversions, offline conversion imports, and attribution modelling.

- Own pixel installation, Enhanced Conversions setup, and tracking troubleshooting. If something is flagged, it gets resolved immediately, not left open.

- Ensure correct tracking and conversion setup alignment across all accounts (GA4, GTM, conversion events, call tracking platforms).

- Build and maintain clean, conversion-focused campaign structures.

- Maintain naming conventions and internal organisation standards.



Strategic Analysis & Reporting

- When performance shifts (positive or negative), provide genuine strategic context: not just metrics, but why it happened and what to do next.

- Deliver monthly reports with period-over-period comparisons, actionable insights, and clear next steps.

- Go beyond surface-level reporting. Understand each client's funnel, conversion setup, and lead sources well enough to provide informed, business-aware commentary.

- Think like a digital strategist, not a task executor. If conversions drop 50%, we need your diagnosis and action plan, not just the numbers.



CRO & Landing Page Awareness

- Review landing pages when traffic is not converting and recommend specific improvements.

- Understand the full conversion path: ad → landing page → form/call → lead quality. Your job does not end at the click.

- Use tools like Microsoft Clarity or GA4 behaviour data to support CRO recommendations with evidence, not assumptions.



Quality Assurance

- Double-check every campaign element before submission: final URLs, ad copy, targeting, budgets, conversion actions, and tracking.

- Errors caught in review (wrong URLs, incorrect ad accounts, misaligned landing pages) reflect directly on your work. We expect a near-zero error rate on basics.

- Cross-reference reports for accuracy before delivery: correct date ranges, matching metrics, proper comparisons.



Internal Process & Communication

- Maintain strong ClickUp task hygiene: accurate statuses, clear optimisation notes, time logged daily.

- Respond to internal mentions within 1-2 hours during core working hours.

title: E-Commerce Technical & Digital Performance Specialist
description:
Full-Time Remote | Long-Term Opportunity | Australian E-Commerce Brand



We are an Australian fashion/e-commerce business looking for an experienced E-Commerce Technical & Digital Performance Specialist to join us full-time remotely.



This is NOT a social media manager role.



We are not looking for someone to simply create Instagram posts, write captions or maintain a content calendar.



We are looking for someone who understands the technical backend of an e-commerce business and can take ownership of our digital ecosystem — Shopify, Google, Meta, tracking, analytics, SEO, advertising infrastructure and performance.



Initially, this will be a hands-on audit, repair and optimisation project. Once the foundations are working correctly, the role will evolve into ongoing digital growth and campaign management.



THE INITIAL PROJECT



Your first responsibility will be to thoroughly review our existing digital setup.



We want you to find what is working, what isn't working, what has been configured incorrectly, what is missing and what can be improved.



This includes reviewing and working directly with:



Shopify — store configuration, apps, integrations, technical issues, site structure and performance



Google Analytics 4 (GA4) — tracking, events, conversions, attribution and reporting



Google Tag Manager



Google Search Console



Google Merchant Center and product feeds



Google Ads — account structure, conversion tracking, audiences and campaign infrastructure



Meta Business Suite / Business Manager



Meta Ads Manager



Meta Pixel and Conversion API


 and Instagram account integration



Shopify/Meta/Instagram catalogue and commerce integrations



Domain verification and associated Meta assets



SEO — technical SEO, on-page SEO, indexing, metadata, site structure, schema and organic search opportunities



Website speed and technical performance



Conversion tracking and attribution



E-commerce analytics and reporting



We don't just want reports telling us there is a problem. We want someone capable of actually fixing the problems.



THEN WE WANT TO GROW



Once the digital foundations are correct, your role will progressively move into performance and growth.



You should be comfortable looking at real business data and understanding what it means.



That includes metrics such as:



Traffic | Conversion Rate | ROAS | CAC | CPA | CTR | CPC | AOV | Revenue | Customer Acquisition | Returning Customers | Funnel Performance | Organic Traffic | Search Rankings



More importantly, you need to understand what levers to pull when those numbers aren't where they should be.



We want someone who can investigate why performance is changing and then take action.



That could mean improving SEO, restructuring a campaign, correcting tracking, improving a landing page, changing audiences, fixing a product feed, improving site structure or identifying another problem within the customer journey.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should have genuine hands-on experience with several of the following:



Shopify / GA4 / Google Tag Manager / Search Console / Merchant Center / Google Ads / Meta Business Manager / Meta Ads Manager / Meta Pixel / Conversion API / Instagram integration / Technical SEO / E-commerce Analytics / CRO



You don't necessarily need to be the world's leading expert in every platform.



But you do need to understand how these systems connect and work together.



We are looking for someone who:



Is technically strong and enjoys solving problems



Can work independently and take ownership



Understands e-commerce and digital performance



Is highly analytical



Can interpret data rather than simply produce reports



Can identify problems and recommend solutions



Is comfortable implementing fixes personally



Can clearly explain what they have found and why it matters



Documents changes and maintains an organised digital environment



Is interested in building something over time rather than completing isolated freelance tasks



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT



This is not primarily:



Social media management, Graphic design, Influencer management, Posting content to Instagram, Writing captions, General virtual assistant work



Those functions may interact with your role, but they are not why we are hiring you.



We are hiring you to understand, manage and improve the technical and performance infrastructure behind our e-commerce business.



THE OPPORTUNITY



We are initially looking at approximately a 6-month full-time engagement, with the potential for this to become a permanent long-term position.



The first stage will focus heavily on auditing, repairing and improving our existing infrastructure.



From there, we want the successful person to become increasingly involved in SEO, Google Ads, Meta advertising, website optimisation, analytics, conversion optimisation and overall e-commerce growth.



You will work directly with the business owners and will have significant ownership over the project.



We care much more about capability, initiative and results than qualifications.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send us a generic application.



Start your application by telling us about yourself and your experience. 



Then answer the following:



1. Tell us about a Shopify store where you personally worked on the technical/performance setup. What did you actually do?



2. What would you check first if Shopify showed 100 orders but GA4 only reported 65 purchases?



3. What are the first things you would audit inside Meta Business Manager for an established e-commerce brand?



4. Explain the difference between Meta Pixel tracking and Conversion API in simple terms.



5. What would you investigate if organic Google traffic had been declining for six months?



6. What are the five most important e-commerce metrics you would want to see every week, and why?



7. Which of these platforms would you consider yourself genuinely advanced in?



Shopify / GA4 / GTM / Search Console / Merchant Center / Google Ads / Meta Business Manager / Meta Ads / Technical SEO / CRO



8. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time position?



9. What country and city are you based in?



10. Please provide examples of e-commerce businesses you have previously worked with and explain your personal involvement.



We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership of the digital engine of the business, understand the numbers, fix the problems and help us grow it.

title: Meta Ads, Google Ads & Social Media Expert (E-commerce Sales, Oman)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

I run two e-commerce stores in Oman, Boothat and Ardor, selling personal-care and wellness products. Some of these products are sensitive under Meta and Google advertising policies. I need one person who owns paid advertising and turns it into real sales, not just clicks. This is a long-term role for someone who can work independently.



PRIORITY RESPONSIBILITIES (in order)

1. Own Meta Ads 
 + Instagram) for both stores: plan, launch, test, and scale campaigns for sales (purchases), not traffic.

2. Keep ad accounts safe and approved. Write compliant ad copy, creatives, and landing-page wording for sensitive categories, and handle policy rejections and appeals.

3. Set up and verify tracking (Meta Pixel + Conversions API, Google tag/GA4) on a local Omani store platform (not Shopify), and confirm purchases are measured correctly before spending.

4. Run Google Ads (Search and Shopping/Merchant Center where policy allows) for high-intent buyers in Oman.

5. Build the creative testing plan: angles, hooks, and offers, and brief my designer. Tailor creatives to Oman (Arabic/English, Instagram-first behavior).

6. Manage budgets by profit, not just platform ROAS: ad spend must stay inside product margin, and selling prices cannot exceed market prices in Oman. Flag products where ads are not profitable.

7. Use offers that fit our delivery rules (delivery fee inside vs outside Muscat, free-delivery threshold) in ad messaging and retargeting.

8. Set up retargeting (cart abandoners, product viewers, past buyers).

9. Support Instagram content: weekly content ideas, captions, and hashtags aligned with the ads.

10. Report weekly: spend, purchases, revenue, ROAS, cost per purchase, and what you will stop, change, or scale next.



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven e-commerce product-sales results on Meta (not only lead generation).

- Hands-on experience with restricted or sensitive ad categories (health, personal care, wellness) and policy appeals.

- Pixel + Conversions API experience on non-Shopify stores.

- Google Ads experience (Search, Shopping, PMax) is a strong plus.

- Advanced English. Arabic is a bonus.

- Able to overlap with Oman business hours (GMT+4).



TOOLS

Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Merchant Center, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Canva or CapCut, Google Sheets.



HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

- Purchases and revenue from ads, and ROAS above break-even after delivery and product cost.

- Ad account health (low rejection rate, no account bans).

- Correct tracking: ad-reported purchases match store orders.

- Clear weekly reports with decisions, not just numbers.



WHAT TO INCLUDE IN YOUR APPLICATION MESSAGE

1. 2-3 e-commerce case studies: ad spend, revenue, ROAS, period, and business type. Screenshots from Ads Manager are welcome (client names can be hidden).

2. The largest monthly Meta budget you have managed.

3. Your experience with sensitive categories and how you handled ad rejections.

4. How you would set up Pixel + Conversions API on a non-Shopify store.

5. Your availability.



START

Paid 2-week trial on a small ad budget, then a long-term role if results are good. Payment will be discussed with shortlisted applicants.



IMPORTANT - HOW TO APPLY (2 steps)

Step 1: Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph through this job post. Start your application message with the word: APPLY, and mention the name "Ibrahim". Applications without the word APPLY will be skipped.

Step 2: After you apply on the site, message me on WhatsApp: 
In your WhatsApp message, write: "APPLY - [your full name]" so I can match you with your application.

I will personally reply to the applicants who meet the requirements.

title: Recruitment Delivery and Talent Manager
description:
Garry Howling Recruitment is a specialist recruitment business operating exclusively across the UK accountancy profession.



We have ambitious plans to build a high-growth, market-leading recruitment business, and we are looking for an exceptional Recruitment Delivery and Talent Manager to take ownership of candidate delivery and help build the high-performance talent function required to support that growth.



This is a hands-on recruitment-delivery position. You will personally identify, approach, engage and qualify high-quality candidates while taking responsibility for ensuring that priority vacancies receive consistent and effective candidate coverage.



The title “Manager” reflects the level of ownership, judgement and accountability required. It is not initially a people-management position. You will be expected to manage candidate pipelines, vacancy coverage, delivery standards, priorities, follow-up and your own performance at an exceptionally high level.



This is not an administrative resourcing role, and it is not suitable for someone who waits to receive a daily list of instructions. We need an intelligent, resilient and commercially aware individual who takes ownership, maintains momentum and makes things happen.



The purpose of the role



You will work closely with the founder of the business, who has more than 20 years’ experience recruiting exclusively within the UK accountancy-practice market.



Your responsibility will be to build and maintain a consistent pipeline of high-quality candidates, qualify them properly and progress them through the recruitment process.



You will undertake the detailed research, sourcing, engagement, qualification and follow-up required before involving the founder at the most commercially important stages.



The objective is not simply to generate names, searches, messages or activity. It is to create genuine candidate conversations, submissions, interviews, offers, successful appointments and long-term relationships.



You will remain responsible for each candidate, vacancy and agreed action until the required outcome has been achieved, accurately recorded and clearly communicated.



Key responsibilities



Candidate sourcing and market mapping



* Proactively identify high-quality accountancy professionals for current and future recruitment opportunities.

* Build detailed talent pools across specific locations, accountancy disciplines and levels of seniority.

* Research candidates thoroughly before making contact.

* Use LinkedIn, recruitment databases, online research, referrals, email, telephone and other appropriate channels.

* Develop effective search strategies rather than relying on obvious job titles or basic keyword searches.

* Map relevant candidates working within national, regional, independent and private-equity-backed accountancy firms.

* Identify candidate movement patterns between different types and sizes of firm.

* Maintain long-term pipelines in areas where suitable candidates are particularly difficult to find.

* Continually expand the business’s understanding of the available candidate market.



Candidate engagement



* Produce persuasive and highly personalised candidate approaches.

* Communicate confidently and professionally with UK accountancy professionals at different levels of seniority.

* Generate genuine interest rather than simply sending high volumes of generic messages.

* Follow up intelligently, consistently and persistently.

* Remain positive and productive when initial approaches receive no response or are rejected.

* Re-engage candidates who may previously have been unavailable or unwilling to consider a move.

* Build trusted relationships with candidates who may not be ready to move immediately.

* Ask candidates for appropriate introductions and referrals.

* Ensure that every worthwhile candidate relationship has a clear and dated next action.



Candidate qualification



* Conduct detailed initial conversations with prospective candidates.

* Establish their current role, responsibilities, technical experience and level of seniority.

* Understand their qualifications, study status and professional development.

* Explore the size and complexity of any client portfolio they manage.

* Establish their client-facing, review, supervisory and team-management responsibilities.

* Understand why they may consider moving and determine the strength of that motivation.

* Record their current salary, expectations, notice period and availability.

* Establish their preferred locations, realistic commuting area and working-arrangement expectations.

* Understand the type, size, culture and ownership structure of firm that would suit them.

* Identify other interviews, applications or recruitment processes already underway.

* Assess counteroffer, withdrawal and non-commencement risks.

* Obtain a current CV and all relevant information before arranging a conversation with the founder.

* Avoid progressing applicants who are unsuitable, weakly motivated or insufficiently qualified.



Vacancy delivery and prioritisation



* Develop a thorough understanding of every priority vacancy.

* Review and prioritise vacancies according to urgency, commercial value and likelihood of success.

* Create a clear candidate-sourcing and engagement plan for each priority assignment.

* Build sufficiently broad pipelines rather than relying on one or two possible candidates.

* Monitor candidate coverage and identify gaps before momentum is lost.

* Maintain a clear, dated next action against every active candidate and vacancy.

* Recognise when a search, message or target market is not producing the required results.

* Diagnose whether problems arise from targeting, candidate availability, outreach, qualification or the vacancy itself.

* Recommend practical corrective action rather than simply reporting that a search is difficult.

* Escalate genuine obstacles promptly, supported by evidence and a recommended solution.

* Ensure that no viable candidate or commercially important vacancy becomes inactive through inadequate follow-up.



Candidate presentation and recruitment-process management



* Match candidates intelligently to suitable vacancies, firms and working environments.

* Prepare accurate and persuasive candidate summaries.

* Ensure that candidates understand opportunities before their details are presented.

* Arrange candidate meetings and interviews efficiently.

* Provide complete and accurate information to everyone involved.

* Prepare candidates thoroughly for interviews.

* Obtain detailed feedback promptly after interviews.

* Progress next steps without avoidable delay.

* Maintain candidate engagement through multiple interview stages.

* Support candidates through offer, resignation and notice-period stages.

* Identify and manage the risk of counteroffers, withdrawals and failed commencements.

* Maintain appropriate alternative candidates until an appointment is secure.

* Continue communicating with placed candidates until they have commenced successfully.



Delivery performance and continuous improvement



* Monitor personal sourcing, engagement and conversion performance.

* Understand where candidates are being lost within the recruitment process.

* Review the effectiveness of searches, messages, follow-up and qualification.

* Test and improve sourcing strategies and candidate approaches.

* Identify patterns in successful and unsuccessful activity.

* Maintain accurate pipeline information and delivery forecasts.

* Provide concise progress updates supported by evidence.

* Critique your own performance honestly and identify specific improvements.

* Help develop consistent delivery standards and processes as the business grows.

* Share observations, ideas and recommended actions rather than waiting to be asked.

* Maintain both pace and quality without allowing either to become an excuse for weakness in the other.



CRM and information management



* Maintain complete and accurate candidate records within the CRM.

* Record all material conversations, messages, motivations, preferences and agreed actions.

* Ensure that notes are sufficiently detailed for another person to understand precisely what has happened and what should happen next.

* Maintain accurate vacancy, interview, offer and placement activity.

* Protect confidential candidate and client information.

* Follow all business procedures relating to data protection, systems and AI use.

* Ensure that every completed action is properly recorded and communicated.



The reality of successful recruitment delivery



Successful recruitment delivery requires intelligence, judgement and strong communication. It also requires the discipline to repeat essential activities consistently.



Researching, searching, approaching, following up, updating records and reviewing pipelines must be completed every working day. Some candidates will not respond. Others will decline opportunities, withdraw or change their minds.



The successful person must be able to maintain pace, accuracy, attention to detail and a positive attitude even when work becomes repetitive or results are not immediate.



Starting a task is not the same as completing it. Sending one message is not effective follow-up. Identifying one candidate is not adequate vacancy coverage. Reporting a difficulty is not the same as recommending and implementing a solution.



We need someone who remains personally responsible for moving work towards the required outcome.



The person we are looking for



The successful applicant will be:



* **Exceptionally proactive:** You act without waiting to be repeatedly instructed.

* **Tenacious:** You remain focused through rejection, non-response and setbacks.

* **Consistent:** You maintain strong standards every day, including when work is repetitive.

* **Accountable:** You accept personal responsibility for your commitments and results.

* **Completion-focused:** You follow work through to its proper conclusion.

* **Commercially aware:** You understand how candidate activity contributes to interviews, placements and revenue.

* **Resourceful:** You can take limited information, research it and determine the best next action.

* **Independent:** You can organise and progress your work without constant supervision.

* **Analytical:** You can identify patterns, diagnose problems and improve your approach.

* **Self-critical:** You review your own work honestly and continually seek improvement.

* **Quality-conscious:** You pursue the highest practical standard while maintaining appropriate pace.

* **Positive and resilient:** You remain constructive and productive when results take time.

* **Highly organised:** You can manage numerous candidates, vacancies, deadlines and follow-ups without losing control.

* **An exceptional communicator:** Your spoken and written English is of an outstanding professional standard.

* **Dependable:** If you commit to an action, it will be completed properly and on time.

* **Adaptable:** You respond constructively to changing priorities within a growing entrepreneurial business.



Essential requirements



* Educated to degree level or able to demonstrate equivalent intellectual and professional capability.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Substantial experience in recruitment delivery, candidate sourcing, executive search or talent acquisition.

* Evidence of personally building and maintaining candidate pipelines.

* Experience conducting candidate screening or qualification conversations.

* Evidence of progressing candidates through recruitment processes.

* Strong online research and talent-mapping capability.

* Confidence communicating with experienced UK professionals.

* Ability to create persuasive, personalised candidate outreach.

* Experience using a CRM, applicant-tracking system or comparable database.

* Excellent attention to detail and record-keeping.

* Demonstrable experience of working independently.

* Evidence of taking ownership and completing work without being chased.

* Ability to sustain consistent activity and standards over time.

* Reliable computer equipment, high-speed internet and a professional home-working environment.

* Availability to work approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. UK time, Monday to Friday.



Experience recruiting within accountancy, financial services or another professional-services market would be advantageous but is not essential.



Performance measures



Success will be assessed through measurable delivery outcomes, including:



* Relevant candidates identified and engaged.

* Meaningful candidate conversations completed.

* Fully qualified candidate meetings booked and attended.

* Current CVs and complete candidate information obtained.

* Suitable candidate submissions made.

* Submission-to-interview conversion.

* Interview-to-offer conversion.

* Offer acceptance and successful commencement rates.

* Candidate pipelines developed and maintained.

* Priority-vacancy coverage.

* Candidate relationships reactivated.

* Candidate referrals generated.

* Speed, quality and consistency of follow-up.

* Accuracy and completeness of CRM records.

* Reliability of pipeline information and forecasts.

* Completion of agreed actions without reminders.

* Evidence of independent judgement and continuous improvement.



Activity matters, but activity without quality, progression or outcomes will not be regarded as success.



Supporting the founder and wider business



You will become a highly dependable extension of the founder and protect his time by ensuring that research, initial engagement and qualification have been completed properly before involving him.



You will:



* Provide concise and commercially useful candidate information.

* Prepare the founder thoroughly for candidate conversations.

* Arrange worthwhile candidate meetings directly into his diary.

* Complete agreed follow-up actions promptly.

* Anticipate what should happen next.

* Raise problems early and provide a recommended solution.

* Create certainty through accurate information, attention to detail and dependable execution.



As the delivery function grows, there may be scope to help establish processes, share best practice and support the development of additional delivery resources. The immediate priority, however, is outstanding personal delivery rather than people management.



 What this role is not



This is not a general virtual-assistant, data-entry or administrative position.



It is not suitable for someone who:



* Needs every task broken down into detailed instructions.

* Waits to be told what to do next.

* Loses motivation when work becomes repetitive.

* Sends one message and considers the task complete.

* Allows candidates or actions to disappear through inadequate follow-up.

* Reports problems without attempting to understand or resolve them.

* Measures contribution purely by hours worked or tasks started.

* Avoids personal accountability when results fall below expectations.



We are looking for somebody who continually asks:



**“What outcome is required, what should happen next, and what can I do now to move this forward?”**



What we offer



* An hourly rate of US$15–$25, depending on experience and capability.

* A full-time, long-term opportunity.

* Close working contact with a recruitment business founder who has more than 20 years of specialist experience.

* Detailed training in the UK accountancy-practice market.

* Access to professional recruitment, research and AI systems.

* The opportunity to take genuine ownership of an important business function.

* Considerable scope for the role to develop as the business grows.

* The opportunity to contribute to the development of a substantial specialist recruitment company.



Engagement details



This is a full-time, self-employed independent-contractor opportunity. The successful applicant will not be employed directly by Garry Howling Recruitment and will be responsible for managing and paying their own tax, statutory contributions, insurance and any other obligations arising in their country of residence.



The contractor must provide suitable computer equipment, a reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional home-working environment.



The role requires availability to work approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. UK time, Monday to Friday. Local working hours will change when the UK moves between British Summer Time and Greenwich Mean Time.



Although this is an independent-contractor engagement, we are looking for someone who wants to work closely with the founder and wider team and make a significant, long-term contribution to Garry Howling Recruitment.



Application process



The selection process is expected to include:



1. CV or résumé submission and initial application review.

2. Shortlisting of selected applicants.

3. A recorded video answering five defined questions.

4. Initial interview.

5. Practical recruitment-delivery assessment.

6. Final interview.

7. Independent-contractor offer.



The recorded-video stage will assess communication, consistency, tenacity, ownership, resilience and self-awareness.



Applicants who progress may also be asked to demonstrate:



* Research and market-mapping capability.

* Written and spoken communication.

* Candidate identification and engagement.

* Candidate qualification.

* Commercial judgement.

* Personal ownership and follow-through.

* Ability to critique and improve their own work.

* Confidence conducting a simulated candidate conversation.

* Ability to produce accurate and detailed written records.



All information and work submitted during the application process must be the applicant’s own and must accurately represent their experience and capabilities.

 campaigns and ongoing social content are not your primary responsibility.



ROLE AND COMPENSATION

• Remote, long-term opportunity, starting at 25 paid hours per week.

• Starting rate: $7.50 USD per hour, paid weekly through Remitly.

• Initial schedule: Monday–Friday, 3:00–8:00 p.m. California time (America/Los_Angeles). Please account for daylight-saving changes in your local time.

• Shortlisted finalists may be invited to a 15-hour paid trial at the same rate. Authorized onboarding, research, meetings, and documentation count toward those hours.

• Any later increase in hours or rate requires a separate agreement; it is not automatic.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• Amazon Seller Central: monitor account health and policy notices, investigate issues, prepare evidence-based resolutions, manage listings and inventory information, and respond to customer questions.

• Shopify operations: maintain products and variants, check inventory locations and stock availability, investigate overselling or order discrepancies, and improve routine store operations.

• Fulfillment: trace orders and inventory across Shopify and Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF), prevent duplicate fulfillment, and verify order status before communicating with customers.

• Customer support: review
 and authorized social/message queues, organize outstanding issues, and prepare clear, accurate responses using approved policies.

• Supplier coordination and product research: follow up on specifications, samples, availability, lead times, and shipping; research practical products for rabbit owners with evidence for suitability, demand, cost, and inventory assumptions.

• Documentation: keep ClickUp tasks, time records, and end-of-day updates current. Document repeatable processes and communicate blockers with the relevant facts and a recommended next step.



WHAT WE REQUIRE

• Real, hands-on Amazon Seller Central AND Shopify experience—not coursework alone.

• Experience managing inventory, orders, fulfillment issues, and customer communication. Explain your MCF experience specifically; do not simply list tools.

• Strong written English, attention to detail, and reliable attendance at agreed meetings.

• Independent research and troubleshooting: review company resources and platform documentation before escalating searchable questions, while asking promptly when a business decision or approval is needed.

• Comfort using ClickUp, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and AI as an assistant while checking its output. Projections must use stated inputs and formulas, not invented sales percentages.

• Reliable internet and a practical backup plan.



HELPFUL BONUSES

ManyChat troubleshooting, rabbit-care or pet-product knowledge, supplier sourcing, TikTok Shop, and demonstrated store-improvement experience. Be honest about what you have used in production and what you are still learning.



HOW WE WORK

We value clear communication, initiative, documentation, and respectful suggestions. Spending, refunds, price or discount changes, and protected live-system changes require approval. You should be able to make progress independently within those boundaries. We provide company-controlled access; never share client credentials or private customer data in your application.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with BURROW READY, then briefly include:

1. Your Amazon and Shopify experience, years of hands-on use, and what you personally owned.

2. One inventory, fulfillment, or account-health problem you personally resolved and how you verified the outcome.

3. Your product-research/supplier experience and any relevant rabbit or pet-product knowledge.

4. Your availability, current commitments, and whether the stated rate and schedule work for you.

5. Your resume and one or two existing, redacted work examples if available.



No new video or lengthy unpaid project is required. Qualified applicants will receive one short, hypothetical written assessment before an interview. Please be specific and honest rather than sending a generic introduction.

title: Content Creator & Storyteller – Sydney Exterior Cleaning | 20 hrs/wk, Full-Time up to US$12/hr
description:
G'day! We're Sweet Home Exterior Cleaning, a pressure cleaning and soft washing company in Sydney, Australia. We clean houses, roofs, driveways and building exteriors, and our crews film everything.



Every day our technicians shoot photos and videos on their iPhones, and everything uploads automatically to a shared iPhone library. We have HUNDREDS of unpublished clips and long raw videos, all REAL jobs with REAL people. No AI, no stock footage.



We're looking for a Content Creator & Storyteller to become the backbone of our content: someone who finds the story in the footage and posts it every day.



THE FEELING

Real, raw and human. Think "a day on the tools with mates" rather than "TV commercial". The dirt, the early starts, the tired roof that's been ignored for 20 years, the customer who can't believe it's the same house. Real and a bit rough beats polished and fake.



We do NOT want over-produced videos, fancy motion graphics or corporate-looking edits. We DO want fast cuts, strong hooks, natural captions and stories that make people feel something.



We're chasing VOLUME first, then quality. We'd rather post 5 good videos today than 1 perfect video this week.



THE TWO FORMATS WE NEED

1. Quick clips (7–20 seconds): satisfying cleans, reveals, close-ups. Several every day.

2. Story videos (60 seconds to 3+ minutes): a person, a problem, a transformation, a reaction. For example: "This house was about to be repainted for $40,000…", "Phil's first roof in the rain", "She hadn't seen her driveway this colour in 15 years."



One job should become at least 5 pieces of content.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Go through our shared iPhone library (new uploads every day plus a big backlog) and turn it into Reels, TikToks, Shorts and carousels

- Post daily on Instagram, TikTok,
 and YouTube Shorts (long-form YouTube and Google Business Profile later)

- Start at 2–3 posts per half-day session and build up to around 5 per session

- Spot trends, formats and sounds on TikTok and Instagram that we can adapt

- Write hooks, captions and on-screen text that sound natural and Australian

- Make our team (Danco the founder, Paulo, Phil) and our customers the recurring characters in our stories

- Ask us for what you need (e.g. "Danco, record a 5-second hook to camera saying X")

- Keep a weekly content calendar and review the numbers with us every week. We'll decide together what to do more of.



HOW YOUR WEEK LOOKS (20 hrs)

- 4 posting sessions (about 4 hrs each): edit, create, post

- 1 strategy session (about 4 hrs): review what worked, research trends, plan next week, send shot requests to the team

- About 80% from existing footage, 20% new creative ideas



YOU MUST HAVE

- An iPhone. Our photos and videos sync through an iPhone Shared Library, so you need one to access and edit them (any computer is fine as well)

- Strong CapCut skills (Canva is a plus)

- Proof you've made content that gets views: links + screenshots of views, reach or follower growth

- Experience creating content for businesses

- Strong storytelling and good written English

- The ability to work fast and independently. You won't be told what to do every day.

- Reliable internet for uploading lots of video



BIG BONUS IF YOU

- Have worked with Australian clients or understand Aussie humour and slang

- Have created content for trades or home-service businesses (cleaning, roofing, plumbing, landscaping, real estate)

- Have grown a TikTok or Instagram account from scratch



HARD RULES

- Never post a customer's house number, street sign or number plate

- The first 2 seconds must have a hook. No slow intros, no logo intros.



PAY AND GROWTH

- Start: US$5–7/hr for 20 hrs/week, depending on proof of results

- Full-time: US$10–12/hr once you've consistently hit your posting targets and we see the numbers growing

- Long term: you lead the content side of the business as we grow



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with "SWEET HOME STORYTELLER". Applications without it won't be read. Then send:



1. A short intro and your available hours (Philippine time)

2. Links to 3–5 videos you created, with screenshots of views or results

3. Businesses or accounts you've made content for (any in Australia?)

4. STORY TEST: "A crew spends 6 hours cleaning a black, mouldy roof in Sydney. The owner is 78 and has lived there 40 years." Give us 3 hooks (the first 2 seconds) AND a 3-sentence outline of the story video you'd make.

5. GUT CHECK: "It's Friday afternoon, you've posted 2 of your 5 videos, and the new uploads are all blurry. What do you do?" (One or two sentences.)

6. Your expected hourly rate (USD)



TRIAL

Shortlisted applicants do a short trial with our real footage. If you can show proof of past results, the trial is PAID. If you're newer and can't show proof yet, you'll do a short free test (about 1 hour). We never post free test work.



We read every application personally. If you love making content that feels real and tells a story, we want to hear from you!

title: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA
description:
Pay: $2/hour + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (24hours/week) any day of your choosing 

Position: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



Finding profitable Amazon seller storefronts: If you discover a strong Online Arbitrage seller storefront that I can use for further product research, submit the storefront to me. If I review it and approve it as a good sourcing opportunity, you can receive a bonus.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 50 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websites



Copycat websites



Suspicious Shopify stores



Random websites with no established reputation



Sources you have not properly researched



A retailer/distributor different from the one you put in the spreadsheet



If you are unsure whether a source is legitimate, DO NOT SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



QUALITY > RANDOM LEADS



I would rather receive 5 strong ASINs than 20 bad ones.



Do not fill the spreadsheet just to hit your number.



Repeatedly submitting products that clearly violate the requirements will result in termination.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



You should have previous experience with:



Amazon Seller Central



Amazon FBA



Online Arbitrage



Product sourcing



Keepa



SellerAmp SAS or similar tools



Buy Box analysis



Sales rank / estimated monthly sales



Amazon fees



Profit calculations



Seller/competition analysis



Variation matching



Source verification



Checking whether Amazon is on the listing



Identifying dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition



Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOURS



Monday–Friday

8 hours per day

40 hours per week



This is a long-term position for the right person.



Starting pay is $2/hour, but strong performance can earn you bonuses and opportunities for increased pay.



The better the products you find and the more value you bring to the business, the more opportunity you have to earn.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?



Have you done Online Arbitrage before?



What sourcing tools have you used?



Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.



Do you know how to use SellerAmp SAS?



How do you determine whether there are too many sellers on a listing?



How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?



How do you determine how many units of a product you would recommend buying?



What is the difference between profit and ROI?



Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find additional profitable products? Explain your process.



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you have worked with before, with any confidential client information removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link that you believe would be worth researching for Online Arbitrage. Briefly explain why you chose it.



If you cannot answer these questions, please do not apply.



I am looking for someone who already knows what they are doing, pays attention to details, follows instructions, verifies their sources, and can consistently find products that I can actually buy and sell.

title: Production Admin Coordinator (Apparel, Remote, Purchase Orders and Production Admin)
description:
This is a great long-term opportunity to join a globally renowned Australian denim and apparel group, with multiple well-known brands sold around the world. We're hiring a Production Admin Coordinator for a brand-new role in their production team, with real opportunity to grow as the team and the business expand.



About the role

You'll provide dedicated administrative and transactional support to the production function, taking the high-volume system, documentation and tracking work off the production managers so they can focus on planning, supplier management and analysis.



The role is defined by accuracy, consistency and turnaround. Your work feeds directly into supplier orders, delivery schedules, finance and the sales team, so data integrity is the single most important part of the job.



You'll own the admin side of the purchase order lifecycle: from raising the PO and sending it to the factory or supplier, through amendments and ex-factory changes, to delivery into the distribution centre. A big part of the day is supplier communication, with 30 to 40 supplier
s most mornings (barcode requests, order questions, site queries and more).



You'll report to the Senior Production Manager and work closely with one other team member day to day, as well as the Production Manager, Product & Denim Manager, Logistics Manager and the supplier base.



What you'll do



Purchase order administration

- Raise bulk, SMS and recut purchase orders in CIN7, accurately matching approved planning and sales close files.

- Upload FOB and international costs, making sure all negotiated discounts and surcharges are correctly applied.

- Add freight and duty costs to all Australian purchase orders.

- Action approved amendments (cancellations, additions, colour and quantity changes) and keep system data aligned.

- Maintain purchase order data through to delivery, including updates when ex-factory dates change or are delayed.



Delivery schedules and data integrity

- Support delivery schedule creation and maintain it as bookings, handovers and revised dates come through.

- Build and maintain the delivery tracker up to the point stock arrives in the DC.

- Run routine data validation checks across CIN7, planning files and delivery schedules, and flag discrepancies.

- Maintain brand cancellation lists and distribute them to the agreed stakeholders.

- Complete the weekly Magellan portal upload and keep the portal current.

- Export CIN7 barcode data for supplier plan sheets and validate recommended retail prices against brand documents.

- Work in supplier Excel files every day (each supplier has its own).



Recut and tracker management

- Place approved recut purchase orders and provide fabric usage detail for the fabric stock list.

- Navigate the PLM (WFX) and export seasonal style data into Excel for recuts.

- Own the recut tracker, uploading purchase order data and ETAs so the sales team has live visibility.

- Keep all production trackers current, accurate and ready for review at agreed checkpoints.



SMS and seasonal administration

- Prepare SMS order templates and raise SMS purchase orders.

- Produce SMS packing lists and split final packing lists by supplier.

- Support seasonal handover documentation to customer service and the international regions.



Supplier and compliance document support

- Chase suppliers for routine documentation (scope certificates, fibre certification, audit and corrective action plan responses) and file it correctly.

- Log compliance documentation in the relevant portals and escalate anything overdue or non-compliant.

- Follow up outstanding supplier confirmations and acknowledgements.



Supplier communication

- Work through the daily supplier inbox so it no longer lands on the production managers.

- Liaise directly with factories and suppliers by
, phone and video call.

- Capture supplier updates, including ex-factory changes and delays and quality issues on P1 and P2 samples, and feed them back concisely.

- Share ex-factory delays promptly with everyone affected, including the sales team, so major retail accounts hear early.



Reporting support

- Prepare recurring reports and data extracts for the production team.

- Compile inputs for margin, DIFOT and factory performance reporting.

- Complete ad hoc administrative tasks as directed.



Not part of this role: creating or maintaining product data (design team), logistics administration and freight forwarder liaison (logistics coordinator), and top-line supply planning.



How success is measured

- Data accuracy across purchase order and delivery schedule entry.

- Turnaround time against agreed service levels for PO placement and amendments.

- Recut tracker, delivery schedules and Magellan portal up to date at agreed checkpoints.

- Low rework rate.

- Supplier document chases closed on time.

- Administrative load released from the production managers.



What you'll need

- 2+ years in a production, supply chain, sourcing or order administration role, ideally in apparel.

- Strong working knowledge of ERP or PLM systems, including managing purchase orders in an ERP (CIN7, NetSuite, SAP or similar).

- Advanced spreadsheet (Excel) skills and proven accuracy with high-volume data.

- Excellent written English and clear, professional supplier communication.

- Excellent spoken English and comfort on phone and video calls with suppliers.

- Highly organised, able to work to deadlines across time zones with minimal supervision.

- Comfortable asking for clarification rather than assuming: accuracy over speed.

- Strong note taking and quick to learn a new system.

- Fully present across a 9am to 5pm working day, comfortable on camera and quick to respond.



Nice to have

- CIN7 or WFX experience.

- An understanding of logistics.



About you

You bring high energy, enthusiasm and engagement. You take the initiative to solve problems and answer your own questions from your notes and recorded training videos, while knowing when to escalate. You keep people updated early, especially when dates slip.



Training

You'll be trained by the Senior Production Manager, with recorded training videos to refer back to. CIN7 experience isn't required on day one: strong note taking makes the difference.



Why join

- A great long-term, full-time opportunity, not a short contract

- Work behind the scenes for a globally renowned denim and apparel group with multiple well-known brands

- Real opportunity to grow: build your skills in CIN7, PLM and international production, and take on more as the team expands

- Structured training from the Senior Production Manager, plus recorded videos to refer back to

- A supportive, organised production team that values accuracy and early communication

- Fully remote, Monday to Friday



Hours

Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm Melbourne time. That's 6:00am to 2:00pm Philippine time while Australian daylight saving is on (October to April), and 7:00am to 3:00pm Philippine time from April to October.



How to apply

Please put "PO Admin" in your subject line so we know you've read the whole ad. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

Send your CV and a short note on the purchase order or ERP systems you've used and the volume of POs you've managed.

title: Backend Manager
description:
Hiring: Backend Manager – E-Commerce / Dropshipping



We are looking for a highly experienced Backend Manager with strong, hands-on experience in e-commerce or/ dropshipping.

We are a Google Dropshipping business generating over $10 million in annual revenue, with 10+ stores and continuing to grow. We are looking for a highly dedicated and reliable VA who is interested in a long-term position and can take full ownership of our backend operations while continuously improving and optimizing our systems. Add brown in your subject line if you read this.



This person will be responsible for overseeing the entire backend operation, ensuring that orders flow smoothly, costs and margins are properly controlled, suppliers are effectively managed, and customer-related issues—including refunds, disputes, and chargebacks—are handled accurately and efficiently.



The ideal candidate should be proactive, detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of working independently while taking ownership of their responsibilities.

Solid e-commerce and dropshipping experience is a MUST. This is not an entry-level position and is not suitable for someone who requires training from scratch. We are looking for someone who already understands the ecommerce backend and can step in, take responsibility, and help us maintain, optimize, and scale our existing systems.



🔥 What We’re Looking For

Proven, hands-on experience managing e-commerce/ dropshipping operations

Strong understanding of overseas dropshipping, including suppliers, fulfillment, shipping, tracking, and delivery processes

Available to work full-time and willing to work longer hours when necessary

Able to take full ownership of the backend operation

Strong experience handling refunds, disputes, and chargebacks

Experience managing or working with phone/customer support agents

Strong understanding of COGS, margins, refunds, fulfillment costs, and overall profitability

Highly organized, proactive, analytical, and detail-oriented

Strong communication and supplier-management skills

Willing to continuously skill up and learn the entire business, including frontend operations

Able to identify problems before they become major issues and take action without waiting for instructions



📌 Key Responsibilities



1. Order Flow & Backend Operations

Monitor the entire order flow from purchase to fulfillment and delivery

Ensure orders are processed accurately and on time

Check for failed, delayed, held, cancelled, or problematic orders

Monitor tracking numbers and shipping status

Identify bottlenecks in the fulfillment process and resolve them quickly

Conduct regular overall backend checks to ensure operations are running smoothly

Ensure all backend processes are being followed according to SOPs



2. Refund & Cancellation Monitoring

Monitor the overall refund percentage and identify unusual increases or trends

Track refunds by product, offer, source, customer issue, and other relevant factors

Review refund reasons and identify recurring problems

Monitor cancellation rates and determine why customers are cancelling

Ensure refunds are processed according to company policies and SOPs

Work with the team to reduce unnecessary refunds while maintaining proper customer service



3. Disputes & Chargebacks

Handle and oversee payment disputes and chargebacks

Prepare and submit appropriate evidence/documentation for disputes

Monitor dispute and chargeback rates

Track dispute outcomes and identify recurring causes

Develop and improve processes to prevent future disputes and chargebacks

Solid prior experience handling e-commerce disputes/chargebacks is required



4. Supplier Management

Communicate directly with overseas suppliers and fulfillment partners

Monitor supplier performance, responsiveness, pricing, and fulfillment times

Follow up on delayed, missing, incorrect, or damaged orders

Resolve supplier-related issues quickly

Negotiate and communicate regarding product costs, shipping costs, and other operational concerns

Ensure suppliers are following our required fulfillment standards

Maintain strong working relationships with suppliers



5. COGS & Margin Monitoring

Monitor COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) across products and orders

Ensure product and fulfillment costs remain aligned with the required margins

Identify increases in product, shipping, or fulfillment costs

Flag products where COGS is negatively affecting profitability

Regularly check whether actual costs match expected costs

Communicate with suppliers when costs need to be reviewed or renegotiated

Work closely with management to protect overall product margins



6. Phone Support Operations

We have a dedicated phone support team, and the Backend Manager will need to understand and oversee how phone support connects with backend operations.

Monitor phone support processes and performance

Ensure phone agents follow proper procedures for orders, cancellations, refunds, and customer concerns

Review escalated customer cases

Identify recurring issues coming from phone support

Ensure information provided by phone agents is accurate and consistent with backend policies

Coordinate with phone agents when an issue requires backend intervention



7. Team Management & Accountability

Manage and oversee backend team members

Assign responsibilities and monitor completion

Review team performance and productivity

Ensure SOPs are consistently followed

Train and coach team members when needed

Handle escalations and critical operational issues

Ensure the backend team maintains a high level of accuracy and accountability



8. Frontend & Overall Business Knowledge

Although the primary responsibility is backend operations, we want someone who is willing to learn the entire business.



You should have, or be willing to develop, working knowledge of:

Product pages and store management

Offers and upsells

Checkout/customer journey

Promotions and discount codes

Basic conversion and sales concepts

Frontend customer experience

How frontend decisions affect refunds, fulfillment, COGS, and overall profitability

Subscriptions

The long-term goal is for the Backend Manager to understand how the entire business operates, not just their individual department.



9. Reporting & Process Improvement

Monitor important operational KPIs

Track orders, refunds, cancellations, disputes, chargebacks, COGS, and fulfillment performance

Prepare regular reports and identify trends

Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend solutions

Create, update, and improve SOPs

Find opportunities to automate repetitive tasks

Continuously improve the backend operation as the business grows



10. Time Management, Team Coordination & Operational Tracking

Manage your own time effectively and prioritize tasks based on operational importance and urgency

Schedule and coordinate regular calls and meetings with team members, suppliers, and other relevant parties

Follow up with team members to ensure tasks and responsibilities are completed on time

Monitor team performance, productivity, and accountability on an ongoing basis

Keep track of important issues, decisions, follow-ups, and outstanding tasks

Document what is working well, what is not working, and what needs to be improved

Maintain a clear record of recurring problems, mistakes, delays, and operational issues so they can be addressed systematically

Proactively identify areas where the team or backend operation can be improved

Make sure important issues do not get forgotten or remain unresolved

Maintain a clear overview of the daily and weekly operational status and communicate important updates to management

title: Video Editor (Meta UGC + Direct Response Ads)
description:
Video Editor (Meta UGC + Direct Response Ads)



Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Compensation: $1,500 USD/month fixed, with a clear path to salary increases

Schedule: At least 3-4 hours a day of overlap with US Central time business hours



About Us

ABG Media is a US-based performance creative and growth agency for DTC ecommerce brands, mainly in supplements, health, wellness, and topicals. We don't just run ads. We install and run a full growth team for the brands we work with: creative strategy, ad production, Meta media buying, landing pages, and retention, all on a clear weekly creative system. You'll work directly with our founder, who has 10+ years of hands-on ecommerce experience, and get trained in the systems we use to grow brands.



Our first and current client is a fast-growing supplement brand built on clean ingredients, no fillers, and real results. We're adding more brands. You'll start on that account and edit across more ABG client accounts as we grow. Video ads are a big part of how we grow every brand we work with.



Role Overview

We're looking for a video editor who knows how to turn raw creator footage into Meta ads that sell. Not pretty videos. Ads that stop the scroll, hold attention, and get people to click and buy.



You'll get briefs and scripts from our Creative Strategist, footage from our UGC creators, and performance feedback from our media buyer. But we don't want a button-pusher, and this role is a path to becoming a Creative Strategist. You'll also have real creative freedom: every week you'll pitch and make some of your own ad ideas, and the best ones get real budget behind them. When there's no creator footage, you'll build ads from B-roll, product shots, voiceover, and AI tools. When an ad wins, you'll recut it into more versions so it keeps winning.



Key Responsibilities



Editing UGC & Direct Response Ads

- Cut creator/UGC footage into 15-60 second Meta ads based on our briefs and scripts.

- Pick the strongest moments from raw footage and pace them so they feel natural and keep attention.

- Add hooks, captions, music, sound effects, product shots, text overlays, and voiceover.

- Write and style native-looking captions (TikTok/Reels style, not overdesigned).



Variations & Sizing

- Create multiple hook/opening variations for each ad (3-5 openings per concept is normal).

- Deliver every ad in 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 for Meta placements.

- Recut and refresh winning ads with new hooks, new footage, new music, or new structures.



Your Own Creative Ideas

- Study competitor ads, the Meta Ad Library, TikTok, and customer reviews to spot hooks, formats, and trends worth stealing (in spirit, not copying).

- Pitch and produce 2-3 of your own concepts each week: your own hook, short script or voiceover, and edit. Run them by the Creative Strategist and they go into testing.

- Take a winning ad and remix it your way: new hook, new structure, new format.



AI & B-Roll Ads

- Build ads from B-roll, stock, product footage, and AI voiceover when no creator footage is available.

- Use AI tools (voice, video generation, avatars, captions) to fill gaps and speed up production.



Workflow & Feedback

- Hit roughly 20-40 finished ads per month (counting variations), depending on complexity.

- Turn around revisions quickly, usually within 24 hours.

- Keep files, project folders, and naming conventions organized so anyone can find any ad.

- Study our top-performing ads to understand why they work, and bring that into your next edits.



Compliance

- No disease claims, no cure or treatment claims, and no exaggerated results in captions, text overlays, or voiceover. If something in the footage crosses that line, flag it or cut it. We'll teach you our rules, but you need to care about following them.



Requirements



Must-Have

- 2+ years editing short-form ads or UGC content, with a portfolio of ads that ran on Meta or TikTok.

- Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, and retention for direct response ads.

- Pro-level skill in Premiere Pro, CapCut (desktop), or DaVinci Resolve.

- Able to deliver 9:16, 4:5, and 1:1 versions cleanly.

- Good written and spoken English: you can read a script and understand what it's really trying to say.

- Fast, reliable, and takes feedback well.

- Creative initiative: you have your own ideas for ads and can write a simple hook and short script yourself.

- Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video work.

- Able to work at least 3-4 hours a day overlapping US Central time.



Nice-to-Have

- Supplement, health, wellness, or beauty brand experience.

- AI tools: ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Runway, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield, or similar.

- After Effects or basic motion graphics.

- Experience with founder-style, mashup, or voiceover-led ads.

- Basic understanding of Meta ad metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR).



What We're Looking For

- A storyteller who can find the ad inside raw footage

- Obsessed with the first 3 seconds

- High output without sloppy work

- Owns their work: hits deadlines and communicates early if something is off

- Wants to get better every week based on real performance data



What We Offer

- $1,500 USD/month fixed salary, with a clear path to salary increases as you deliver and as we grow

- Ongoing training in our direct response ad systems

- Work directly with our founder (10+ years in ecommerce) and our Creative Strategist

- Long-term, full-time role with a growing agency: start on one brand and add accounts as we sign new clients

- Clear briefs and scripts from a dedicated Creative Strategist

- Creative freedom to pitch and make your own ads, plus real performance feedback so you can see which ones win

- A real path into a Creative Strategist role: editors whose own ideas win get trained into strategy as we grow

- Or grow into a Senior Editor / Lead Editor role as we scale

- Remote work with a small, high-standard team



Application Instructions (Please Read)

Start your application with the words "CLEAN CUT" so we know you read this post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Please include:

1. A short intro: years of experience, the brands or niches you've edited for, and your editing software.

2. REQUIRED SAMPLE: Links to 3 ads you edited (Google Drive, YouTube, or portfolio links; make sure they're viewable). Ads that ran on Meta are preferred. For each one, tell us in one line what you did (full edit, hooks only, captions, etc.).

3. The AI tools you use regularly, if any, and what you use each one for.

4. ONE AD IDEA OF YOUR OWN: for any DTC supplement or wellness product, give us a hook line and a 3-5 line script or shot list for an ad you'd make. Supplement-safe: no disease or cure claims.

5. Confirm the $1,500/month starting pay works for you.

6. Your time zone and how many hours a day you can overlap with US Central time.



Applications without 3 sample ads and your own ad idea will not be considered. We'll review applications and shortlist within about a week. Finalists will complete a short paid test edit using footage we provide before we make an offer.

Location: Remote

Compensation: $2,000 USD/month fixed, with a clear path to salary increases

Schedule: At least 3-4 hours a day of overlap with US Central time business hours



About Us

ABG Media is a US-based performance creative and growth agency for DTC ecommerce brands, mainly in supplements, health, wellness, and topicals. We don't just run ads. We install and run a full growth team for the brands we work with: creative strategy, ad production, Meta media buying, landing pages, and retention, all on a clear weekly creative system. Our first and current client is a fast-growing supplement brand built on clean ingredients, no fillers, and real results. We're adding more brands. You'll start on that account and work across more ABG client accounts as we grow. For our brands, creative is the biggest growth lever there is.



The customers our brands serve are real people with real problems: women going through menopause, people trying to lose weight, people who can't sleep, people tired of products full of chemicals they can't pronounce. They've tried everything else. Our ads need to speak to them honestly and give them a reason to try something clean.



Role Overview

The Creative Strategist is the brain of our creative engine. You decide what we test and why. You'll dig into customer reviews, competitor ads, and our clients' Meta data to find the angles, hooks, and avatars that turn scrollers into buyers. Then you'll turn those ideas into clear briefs and scripts for our video editor, static designer, and UGC creators.



You'll work directly with our media buyer, video editor, static designer, and creator manager. You will own the creative pipeline for every account you work on, and that means making sure it never runs dry.



Key Responsibilities



Creative Strategy & Research

- Own the angles, hooks, customer avatars, and messaging for every client product we advertise.

- Mine customer reviews, Amazon reviews, Reddit, TikTok, comment sections, and the Meta Ad Library for customer language, pain points, objections, and buying triggers.

- Build and maintain an avatar and angle library for each client brand and product (starting with our current client's hormone balance, weight/gut/detox, sleep, pain relief, and skin and hair lines).

- Spot new formats and trends before they get saturated, and adapt them to each brand.



Briefs & Scripts

- Write 10-15+ creative briefs per week across static ads, UGC, and edited video ads.

- Write UGC and voiceover scripts with multiple hook options for each concept.

- Define the headline, hook, visual direction, footage/shot needs, CTA, and references in every brief, clear enough that the team can execute without a back-and-forth.

- Brief our creator manager on what creators need to film and say.

- Review finished creatives before launch and give specific, actionable feedback.



Performance Analysis

- Analyze Meta creative performance weekly for each account: hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, and AOV.

- Break down what is working and why, by angle, hook, format, avatar, and offer.

- Spot fatigue early and plan iterations of winners (new hooks, new formats, new sizes) before they die.

- Send a short weekly creative report: what won, what lost, what we learned, and what's next.



Collaboration & Workflow

- Work closely with the media buyer on what to test next and how to structure tests.

- Lead a weekly creative review with the editor, designer, and creator manager.

- Keep our briefs, creative tracker, and testing pipeline organized and up to date.



Compliance

- Make sure every concept and script is safe for supplement advertising. No disease claims, no cure or treatment claims, no exaggerated promises, and nothing that breaks Meta's health and wellness ad policies. Example: we never say a product "cures," "treats," or "prevents" a condition. You need to know how to write ads that convert without crossing that line.



Requirements



Must-Have

- 2+ years of creative strategy for DTC paid social (Meta required).

- Real ads you briefed or scripted, with results you can show or talk through (spend, ROAS, CPA, hook rate, or anything else you tracked).

- Strong grasp of direct response fundamentals and buyer psychology.

- Ability to think in angles and avatars, not just visuals.

- Experience writing briefs and scripts for designers, editors, and UGC creators.

- Comfortable reading Meta Ads Manager data and turning it into decisions.

- Excellent written English and clear spoken English for calls and Loom videos.

- Able to work at least 3-4 hours a day overlapping US Central time.



Nice-to-Have

- Supplement, health, wellness, or beauty brand experience.

- Experience with compliance-sensitive categories.

- UGC creator sourcing or management experience.

- Familiar with tools like Motion, Foreplay, Triple Whale, Shopify, or Amazon.

- Basic editing or design skills (CapCut, Canva, Figma) for rough mockups.

- Experience using AI tools for research, scripting, or concept mockups.



What Matters Most To Us: Work Ethic and Ownership

We'll be direct: work ethic and ownership matter more to us than anything else on this list. We want someone who treats every client brand like it's their own. That means:

- You don't wait to be told what to test next. You come with the plan.

- When an ad flops, you dig into why and fix it without making excuses.

- When the pipeline is empty, you fill it.

- You hit your deadlines and communicate early when something is off.

- You care about the result (sales), not just finishing the task.

If you want a role where you get told exactly what to do every day, this isn't it. If you want to own the creative for fast-growing DTC brands and grow with us, keep reading.



What We're Looking For

- Data-driven but creative

- Obsessed with testing, learning, and iterating

- Fast, organized, and reliable

- Comfortable producing 10-15+ briefs per week

- Strong communicator and team player



What We Offer

- $2,000 USD/month fixed salary, with a clear path to salary increases as you deliver and as we grow

- Ongoing training in our creative strategy and direct response systems

- Work directly with our founder (10+ years in ecommerce), not a middle manager

- Long-term, full-time role with a growing agency: start on one brand and add accounts as we sign new clients

- Your ideas get tested fast

- Real ownership over the creative direction of the brand

- Room to grow into a Head of Creative role as we scale

- Remote work with a small, high-standard team



Application Instructions (Please Read)

Start your application with the words "CLEAN ANGLES" so we know you read this post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Please include:

1. A short intro: years of experience, the brands or niches you've worked on, and your current role.

2. 2-3 examples of real ads you briefed or scripted, with the results (links, screenshots, or a short description of the numbers).

3. REQUIRED SAMPLE: 3 angle ideas for one product from any DTC supplement or wellness brand of your choice. For each angle, include:

   - Target avatar (who it's for)

   - The angle (the core idea / reason to buy)

   - 1-2 hook lines

   - Suggested format (static, UGC, voiceover video, etc.)

   Keep it supplement-safe: no disease or cure claims.

4. Confirm the $2,000/month starting pay works for you.

5. Your time zone and how many hours a day you can overlap with US Central time.



Applications without the angle sample will not be considered. We'll review applications and shortlist within about a week. Finalists will complete a short paid test project before we make an offer.

description:
