title: Operations Manager | Project Administration & Systems
description:
Are you a proactive, highly organised person with a passion for bringing order and efficiency to a busy business? Build Prestige Homes is a growing design and construct builder of premium custom homes based in Brisbane, Australia, and we are looking for someone like you to be our operational backbone as our Virtual Operations Manager.



This is not about ticking boxes. Our systems and procedures are not yet fully documented. Your role is to develop, improve and then turn the necessary procedures into daily practice, take ownership of our processes and free the directors to focus on clients, growth and strategy. If you thrive on making a tangible difference, keeping jobs running smoothly and helping a 

business reach its full potential, we want to hear from you.



You will work closely with the directors, our estimator and our designer in a fast-paced, professional environment, with the opportunity to grow alongside the business. This is a full-time independent contractor engagement of 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with flexible hours worked between 8:00am and 7:00pm Brisbane time (Australian Eastern Standard Time).



We offer flexible working times, Philippine public holidays off with regular holidays paid, your birthday off as a paid holiday, training and support for your growth and development, the ability to grow with the team and working from home.

 

Position Requirements

• At least 3 years of experience in an administration, operations or project coordination role, ideally in residential building, construction or trades

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to draft professional correspondence

• Proficient with project management software (experience with Wunderbuild is highly regarded)

• Experience with Xero or similar accounting software for cost tracking and reconciliation

• Proficient in Microsoft Office including Excel and Word

• Experience building and maintaining workflows and standard operating procedures in Notion or a similar platform

• Experience with creating Looms

• Comfortable with digital tools, including AI tools, and quick to learn new software

• High level of organisation and attention to detail, particularly with documentation, compliance and financial data

• Strong problem-solving ability and initiative

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the drive to implement solutions and not only identify problems

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities and work independently with minimal supervision

• Positive attitude and adaptable to change

• Good practical judgement and common sense

• Reliable computer, stable internet connection and a suitable work environment

 

Key Responsibilities

Systems & Process Ownership

• Develop and improve our standard operating procedures and operational standards, then make sure they are followed in daily practice

• Build and maintain a central online hub for workflows and procedures (Notion or similar) that works as a searchable knowledge base

• Document administrative workflows and decision-making processes and create standard operating procedures for recurring tasks

• Record and organise Loom videos for internal training, processes and procedures

• Maintain checklists for recurring operational tasks so they are completed consistently on every job

• Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements, including automation where it reduces manual work

Job Management in Wunderbuild

• Monitor job progress daily and ensure every stage is updated with photos and actions

• Keep job schedules current, with tasks assigned and supporting documents attached

• Maintain and categorise contacts, with preferred suppliers and subcontractors flagged

• Keep estimate information accurate and up to date in support of the estimator

• Complete weekly client site diaries for every active job

• Create and maintain Wunderbuild templates

Quotes & Variations

• Issue Requests for Quote to subcontractors and suppliers and track responses, keeping communication professional and respectful of our trade relationships

• Prepare variations from start to finish: gather pricing, enter the variation in Wunderbuild ready for director approval and update the job budget once the client has accepted

Financial Administration

• Upload, allocate, track and reconcile supplier invoices and receipts against each job in Xero and Wunderbuild, with back costing updated daily

• Follow up missing invoices and receipts

• Track job profitability and budget adherence and report the financial position of each job to the directors

• Complete and document the monthly financial compliance checklist

Work Health & Safety Documentation

• Own the work health and safety documentation for every job and every person on site

• Collect, check and file the required safety documents and evidence, with polite follow-up of anything outstanding

Communication & Coordination

• Manage and triage the main business inbox daily: draft replies, respond to routine enquiries and escalate critical items to the directors

• Coordinate communication with clients, subcontractors and suppliers as required

• Support the flow of information between the designer and the estimator

 

Key Performance Indicators

• Systems & Procedures: central hub in daily use and every recurring task documented

• Wunderbuild: every active job updated daily and weekly client site diaries completed on time

• Financial Control: back costing up to date daily and job profitability reported weekly

• Quotes & Variations: issued and prepared within agreed timeframes

• Work Health & Safety: documentation complete and current for every active job

• Communication: main inbox triaged daily and critical items escalated the same day

 

Meetings & Reporting

Attend a daily 15 minute meeting with the director or general manager to get the decisions needed to progress work

Run the weekly operations meeting, including the agenda, minutes and follow-up of agreed actions

Keep the weekly KPI scorecard up to date and report on job status, budget position and anything off track 



Preferred Experience

• Experience in residential construction or the building industry

• Hands-on experience with Wunderbuild and Xero

• Experience setting up Notion or a similar knowledge base

• Familiarity with Association of Professional Builders (APB) or The Profitable Builder (TPB) systems

 

Application Requirements

To show you have read this advert in full, start your application with the phrase “Pizza is perfection”. Applications without it will not be considered.



Please also submit a short video outlining:

• Why you are interested in the position

• How your experience aligns with the position requirements and key responsibilities

• A system or procedure you built from scratch and the result

• Your desired income

• Areas where you may require further training

title: Short-Form Content Creator & Growth Operator — Travel Startup (Part time, Long term)
description:
FlightClaimly is a European travel-tech startup helping passengers pursue compensation when flights are delayed, cancelled or otherwise disrupted.



We are primarily looking for a strong short-form content creator — NOT a general Virtual Assistant.



You should already be able to show TikToks, Instagram Reels, short-form videos or social content that YOU personally created. We care about strong hooks, pacing, visual quality, storytelling and understanding what makes people stop scrolling and take action.



We are looking for someone creative, commercially minded and highly reliable who can work directly with the founder and help turn FlightClaimly into a recognizable travel brand.

This is not a role where you simply receive a list of tasks and complete them. We want someone who can spot opportunities, suggest ideas, create the content, distribute it and learn from the results.



You will help us:

• Create short-form TikTok / Instagram Reels /
 content

• Turn flight disruptions, passenger-rights topics and travel news into engaging content

• Develop strong hooks, scripts, captions and CTAs

• Edit videos using CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar tools

• Create visual assets using Canva, Photoshop or similar tools

• Research trends, airlines, airports, creators and travel conversations for content opportunities

• Find smart ways to distribute content rather than simply posting and waiting

• Identify creator, affiliate and partnership opportunities

• Track views, retention, clicks, website traffic and customer actions

• Use performance data to d
 what we should create more of — and what we should stop doing



You should have:

• Excellent English

• Proven experience creating short-form social content

• Strong instincts for hooks, pacing and attention

• Video editing experience

• Good visual judgment

• An understanding of the difference between content that gets views and content that drives action

• Excellent attention to detail

• The ability to work independently, suggest ideas and communicate clearly

Experience with TikTok/Reels growth, performance creative, creator outreach, paid social, affiliate marketing or startups is a plus.



IMPORTANT: Applications without examples of short-form content YOU personally created will not be shortlisted.

FlightClaimly operates in an area involving passenger rights, so accuracy matters. You will receive verified company facts and clear guidelines. We never invent legal claims, statistics or promises simply to make content perform.

We are starting at approximately 10 hours per week. For the right person, this can become a much larger and long-term role as FlightClaimly grows.



HOW TO APPLY

title: Virtual Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist (30-Day Paid Trial)
description:
Job Opening: Virtual Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist (30-Day Paid Trial)



Employers: Edgett Law Firm (criminal and juvenile defense) and Edgett Hawk A
 & Injury Law (personal injury)

Location:  McKinney, Texas (virtual)

Type: 30-day paid trial, with the mutual option of a long-term role or standard monthly retainer

Reports to: Scott Edgett, CEO and Mallory Edgett CFO

 

About Us

Edgett Law Firm defends adults and juveniles facing criminal charges in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. Edgett Hawk A
 & Injury Law, a partnership between Scott Edgett and Michael Hawk, represents people injured in a
. The two practices have separate brands, audiences and messaging. You will keep them distinct, with separate accounts, ad copy, social pages and tone. We are replacing our current marketing support. We want someone who can build and run a lead engine quickly and who understands that law firm advertising is regulated.



The Role

In the first 30 days you will set up, launch and run paid and local lead-generation channels for both firms. Your goal is qualified calls and form leads as soon as possible. You will also publish daily social media content. Base salary plus bonus payments if over a certain number of qualified leads contact us within the month (details below). 



Immediate Responsibilities

1. Local Services Ads (LSA)

• Set up, verify, maintain, and manage daily the Google Local Services Ads profiles for each firm: business verification, license and insurance documents, service areas and practice categories.

• Manage budgets, bids, hours, lead disputes and review requests.

• Report weekly on leads, cost per lead, booked and disputed leads.



2. Google Ads (PPC)

• Modify or Rebuild and launch PPC Search campaigns separately for criminal defense, juvenile defense and personal injury.

• Do keyword research, create ad groups and write compliant ad copy and extensions.

• Build negative keyword lists, location targeting and call tracking.

• Set up conversion tracking for calls, forms and chats, with correct attribution.

• Optimize daily in week one, then at least twice a week.



3. Google Business Profile (GBP)

• Claim, verify and optimize each firm's profile: categories, services, hours, photos, attributes, Q&A and description.

• Post updates at least weekly and respond to reviews professionally, never revealing client information.

• Set up an ethical review-request process.

• Monitor for suspended listings, duplicates and spam edits.



4. Meta 
 and Instagram)

• Set up Business Manager, Pages, Instagram accounts, Pixel/Conversions API and Lead Ads for each firm.

• Launch and manage lead-generation and awareness campaigns with approved creative.

• Follow Meta's special-category and legal advertising policies.

• Build retargeting audiences from website visitors and engagement, using only lawful, non-confidential data.



5. Daily Social Media Posts and/or Videos

• Publish one post and/or video every day for each law firm (30 posts in the trial for criminal/juvenile and 30 posts for personal injury for a total of 60) across each firm's 5 social media channels, according to the content calendar.

• Mix educational content, community content, FAQs, short video scripts, reviews (with permission) and calls to action.

• Respond to comments and messages within one business day. Route any message that contains case facts to an attorney.

• A sample 30-day calendar is below. You are expected to improve it.



6. Reporting

• Daily: spend, leads and any issues, in a short message.

• Weekly: a one-page dashboard covering cost per lead, call volume, lead quality, top keywords and next steps.

• Day 30: a full review with a recommendation and a proposed budget.



30-Day Trial Plan

Days Milestone

1–2          Access audit. Account setup for Google Ads, LSA, GBP and Meta. LSA & PPC live. Tracking, call tracking and compliance checklist.

3–6         Launch GBP optimization and first Google Ads campaigns. Submit LSA verification. Start daily posts.

7–14 Launch Meta campaigns. Additional landing pages (2 per practice area x 2 = 4) once approved by leadership. First optimization round. First weekly report.

15–30 Scale what works and cut what does not. A/B test creative. Review requests live. Final report and recommendation on Day 30.



Requirements

Must have-

• At least a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience running Google Ads and Meta Ads for lead generation, ideally for law firms or other local service businesses would be a plus.

• Direct experience with Google Local Services Ads and Google Business Profile.

• Working knowledge of conversion tracking (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, call tracking).

• Strong writing skills and the ability to create or source graphics and short video.

• Ability to start immediately and show a portfolio or references with results.

• Willingness to follow attorney review of all ads and posts before publication, if necessary in the beginning.

Nice to have-

• Attorney/Lawyer/Law Firm paid marketing background is definitely a plus. 

• Familiarity with CRM and intake tools, such as MyCase, Attorney Fuel, FileVine or similar.

• Experience with both criminal defense and personal injury marketing.



Compliance and Confidentiality

• All ads, posts, landing pages and review responses must never state the word of inference of specializing or specialized. A member of the leadership team approves everything before it goes live, if necessary.

• No guarantees of results, no misleading claims, and no use of client information, case facts or testimonials without written consent.

• The firms own all accounts, pages, ad accounts, domains, creative and data. The Specialist is added as an admin and must never set up accounts in their own name or on their own business assets.

• A confidentiality agreement is required.



Compensation

• 30-day paid trial: paid directly by the firms to the employee on a biweekly basis on Fridays.

• After the trial: a more than fair monthly retainer or salary with the option of performance bonuses tied to qualified leads per month.

• Bonus Opportunities:
Qualified Leads Per Month = $500 Bonus;
Qualified Leads Per Month = $750 Bonus; and 300+ Qualified Leads Per Month = $1000 Bonus.

• There is no commission on ad spend, and no long-term contract is required.



Success Measures for the Trial

• All four channels (LSA, Google Ads, GBP and Meta) updated and/or rebranded and live within the first 7 days, subject to platform approvals.

• First qualified leads within the first 3-5 days.

• Daily posts published on schedule, 30 out of 30.

• Clean tracking, so every lead is attributed to a source.



How to Apply

 your resume, portfolio and salary requirements, along with a short description of the results you produced for a law firm or local service business and how you would implement your previous success in this new law firm opportunity, to 
 line: Digital Marketing Trial – [Your Name]

Include your earliest start date and your trial fee proposal. Requesting immediate availability to start working with the law firms. 

Edgett Law Firm and Edgett Hawk A
 & Injury Law are equal opportunity employers.

title: Phone Sales & Client Onboarding Specialist – Time For Tutoring

Who we're looking for:

- Proven ability to handle objections and close without being pushy

- Someone who builds trust easily and can maintain long term relationships with families

title: Senior Publishing Designer
description:
Senior Publishing Designer

Client: Publishing Company

Department: Design

Hours: Full-time, 9:30am- 5:30pm U.K. Time 

Seniority Level: Senior or Executive

Salary: From GBP 950 monthly (TBD)



Role Overview



We are looking for a highly capable Publishing Designer to support the design and production of children’s books, accessible reading materials, licensed projects, annuals, symbolised texts, and related visual assets.

This role is best suited to a confident, creative and detail-focused designer who can take clear briefs, work quickly, produce visually strong layouts, and contribute ideas where appropriate. The client is not necessarily looking for someone who has come directly from a traditional publishing background. Instead, the priority is finding a strong layout designer with excellent Adobe skills, a creative eye, the ability to follow detailed briefs, and the confidence to speak up when something can be improved.



The formal UK role requires a Senior Designer who can lead visual development, manage publishing projects from concept to production, collaborate with editorial, production, marketing and external partners, maintain accessible publishing standards, and prepare technically accurate print-ready files. The meeting added further context that the client wants someone who can “make it look fabulous” when given assets, layouts and direction, particularly across creative children’s books, annuals and accessible formats.



About the Client



We are an award-winning children’s publisher based in the U.K. The wider group also includes a major online books retailer. We have a strong mission around inclusive reading and produces books for children across a broad range of needs, including specialist accessible books for children with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities.

We are highly inclusive, fast-moving, commercially focused and creatively ambitious. We want someone who can become part of the team remotely, communicate well, and contribute to a business that is willing to do things differently from traditional publishers.



Core Purpose of the Role

The designer will support the visual execution of high-quality children’s publishing projects, helping the internal team bring books, layouts, covers, symbols, marketing assets and print-ready files to life.



The role will involve:

Turning detailed briefs, supplied assets and page plans into polished book layouts.

Designing children’s publishing materials that are visually engaging, commercial and age-appropriate.

Supporting accessible publishing projects, including symbolised texts and SEND-focused formats.

Preparing print-ready artwork with strong technical accuracy.

Working across covers, internal layouts, annuals, licensed projects, promotional materials and digital assets.

Collaborating with editors, writers, production, marketing and design tea
mbers.

Bringing ideas to the table when appropriate, while still being able to follow direction closely.



Key Responsibilities



Design & Layout

Design book layouts for children’s publishing projects.

Create covers, internal spreads, visual assets, annual-style layouts and supporting sales/marketing materials.

Work from supplied assets, flatplans, editorial direction and page-by-page briefs.

Maintain visual consistency across titles, imprints, series and licensed brands.

Produce engaging layouts suitable for children, young readers and accessible reading audiences.

Support special design tasks such as artworking, colour correction, resizing, resending artwork and adapting existing files.



Accessible & Inclusive Publishing

Support the accessible books range.

Help create and maintain symbolised texts and accessible formats.

Design new symbols where required, following editorial and SEND-specialist guidance.

Maintain consistency within the symbol library / symbol dictionary.

Understand the importance of accessibility, clear typography and inclusive design.



Print Production & Technical Artwork

Prepare print-ready files to the required technical specifications.

Ensure files follow correct printing guidelines.

Set up finishing layers where needed, including spot UV, foil, embossing or similar finishes.

Review proofs and check that quality-control standards are met.

Ensure accuracy across typography, layout, image placement, file setup and final artwork delivery.



Collaboration & Communication

Work closely with editors, writers, production teams, marketing and other designers.

Take part in development or visualisation meetings when needed.

Communicate clearly if deadlines, quality or production requirements are at risk.

Be comfortable receiving constructive feedback and making changes quickly.

Speak up when something does not look right or when a better design solution is possible.



Creative Contribution

Bring creative ideas to the table where appropriate.

Contribute to project development rather than only completing isolated design tasks.

Be confident enough to suggest improvements while remaining collaborative and easy to work with.

Support the team’s fast-paced, commercially focused approach.



Required Skills & Experience



**Essential

Strong experience in layout design, ideally within publishing, editorial design, print design, children’s products, stationery, educational materials, magazines, books or similar.



Advanced Adobe Creative Suite skills, especially (ALL REQUIRED)

-Adobe InDesign 

-Adobe Illustrator

-Adobe Photoshop



Excellent layout, typography and visual composition skills.

Strong portfolio showing high-quality layout and design work.

Good understanding of print production and preparing final artwork.

Ability to work quickly while maintaining strong design standards.

Excellent attention to detail.

Strong communication skills.

Ability to follow detailed briefs and work independently.

Confidence to ask questions, challenge constructively and raise concerns when needed.

Ability to take feedback positively and apply it quickly.

Strong time management and ability to handle multiple projects.

InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop are the key required tools. 

Layout design experience “in any capacity” would be highly relevant.



**Desirable Skills

Experience in children’s publishing or children’s product design.

Experience with accessible reading, SEND materials, symbolised texts or inclusive design.

Experience with licensed projects and working from brand/style guides.

Experience preparing books, magazines, annuals or educational content for print.

Experience using publishing or project management systems such as Stison.

Familiarity with Slack or similar internal communication tools.

Basic animation or Adobe After Effects experience would be useful but is not essential.

Experience contributing ideas in creative development meetings.

Experience mentoring junior designers or supporting other creatives.



Stison, Slack and After Effects are useful but not essential. 

After Effects is specifically positioned as a “nice to have” because the team sometimes uses animation.



Ideal Candidate Profile



The ideal candidate is not just a technical designer. They should be someone who has creative judgement, confidence and a practical mindset.

The client is looking for someone similar to a high-performing existing designer in the business: someone who can be given a brief, understand the desired outcome, produce something strong, take feedback well, and make work look polished without needing excessive hand-holding.



They should be:

Creative and visually strong.

Fast, practical and commercially aware.

Detail-oriented without becoming too slow.

Confident enough to have their own voice.

Comfortable speaking up if something is not right.

Able to balance speed and quality.

Positive, proactive and can-do.

Able to follow a process from beginning to end.

Comfortable working with a fast-moving, informal and highly inclusive team.

Open to constructive criticism.

Team-oriented and easy to communicate with.

We emphasize that we want someone with a “can-do attitude”, confidence, and their “own voice”, rather than someone passive who simply waits for instructions. We also want to make it clear that the role requires someone who can balance speed and quality, and who can confidently say when a rushed deadline may affect the final standard.



Working Style & Communication



We operate in a fast-paced environment where projects need to move quickly. The designer should be able to receive a clear brief, produce work efficiently, respond quickly to feedback and maintain high standards.

The team is open to the Remote Specialist working Philippines-based hours, provided communication works well. However, occasional overlap with the UK team will be useful, especially for calls where it is quicker to explain or show a task live.



The successful candidate should be comfortable:

Joining calls when needed.

Receiving visual feedback.

Making quick amendments.

Working from detailed briefs.

Communicating progress clearly.

Asking sensible questions.

Being treated as part of the wider team, not just an outsourced freelancer.



Portfolio Requirements



Candidates should provide a portfolio showing relevant design work. Strong examples may include:

Book layouts

Children’s book designs

Magazine or editorial layouts

Educational resources

Annuals or activity books

Covers

Print-ready artwork

Character-led or illustration-heavy layouts

Accessible or inclusive design projects

Product, stationery or packaging layouts where strong design judgement is evident

Publishing experience is beneficial, but not mandatory if the candidate has strong layout design ability and a portfolio that shows they can adapt to children’s publishing.

title: Sales & Account Growth Manager — SaaS for Fashion Industry (Remote)
description:
About the role

We are a SaaS platform that helps fashion brands manage their product development (tech packs, purchase orders, shipments, supplier communication). Think of it as the operating system for apparel brands.



I'm looking for someone who will own revenue growth. That means running demos to close new business, onboarding the clients you sell, and then growing those accounts over time. You're not a support person who occasionally sells — you're a salesperson who makes sure your clients succeed so they stick around and expand.



What you'll actually be doing

Prospecting and outreach to fashion brands who'd benefit from the platform (mostly calls will be booked via ads for you). Running live demos via Google Meet, handling objections, and closing deals. Managing email communication with prospects and clients throughout the sales cycle and beyond — you'll need to stay on top of threads, follow up promptly, and keep conversations moving as deal cycles can take 14-30 days. Onboarding new clients you've sold — training them on the platform so they get value fast. Managing ongoing client relationships to reduce churn and identify upsell opportunities. Keeping the CRM updated with pipeline activity, deal stages, and client notes — if it's not in the CRM, it didn't happen. You'll be trained on the product — you don't need to know it already. But you do need to be someone who takes ownership of a number and finds ways to hit it.



Requirements

Native or near-native American English is non-negotiable. You'll be on calls with US-based brand owners and need to communicate clearly and confidently. Proven track record in sales — you've carried a quota before and can talk about how you hit it. Strong written communication — a big part of this role is email. Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or similar). Self-starter who doesn't need to be micromanaged. Available during US business hours.

Compensation



$1,000–$1,500 USD/month base depending on experience, plus commission on every deal you close. This is a ground-floor role at a growing startup — the better you sell, the more you make, and the role grows with the company.



To apply

Include a short voice recording (60–90 seconds) introducing yourself and telling me why you'd be a good fit. Applications without a recording won't be considered. I'm looking to fill this within 48 hours! :)

title: # Full-Time Digital Marketing & SEO Manager
description:
**Company:** Total Plumbing Air Electric  

**Position:** Digital Marketing & SEO Manager  

**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Dedicated Position  

**Industry:** Plumbing, HVAC, Electrical & Solar Services



## About the Position



Total Plumbing Air Electric is seeking an experienced, results-driven **Digital Marketing & SEO Manager** to take full ownership of our entire digital marketing operation.



This is a hands-on, full-time position. You will be responsible for SEO, Google Ads, PPC, Google Local Services Ads, Google Business Profile, Google Maps optimization, Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising, website optimization, landing pages, analytics, conversion tracking, and overall digital lead generation.



Our primary objective is to consistently generate **qualified inbound phone calls, service requests, booked jobs, and revenue** while continuously improving our cost per qualified lead.



## Independent Work Environment



**This is an independent position. You will primarily be working by yourself and will be expected to manage the company's digital marketing operation without constant supervision.**



You must be comfortable working independently, managing your own workload, identifying priorities, solving problems, and taking projects from start to finish.



This position is ideal for someone who does not need to be constantly told what to do.



You will be expected to:



- Work independently and manage your own daily workload.

- Take full ownership of the company's digital marketing.

- Identify problems and opportunities without waiting for management to point them out.

- Develop and execute marketing strategies independently.

- Prioritize tasks based on their impact on leads and revenue.

- Troubleshoot SEO, advertising, tracking, and website issues.

- Research solutions when problems arise.

- Meet deadlines without constant supervision.

- Provide management with clear updates on completed work, results, problems, and next steps.

- Maintain a structured daily and weekly work schedule.

- Be accountable for measurable results.



Although management will establish company objectives and approve major budgets and strategic decisions, **you will be expected to independently determine and execute the day-to-day work necessary to achieve those objectives.**



## Exclusive Full-Time Employment Requirement



This is a **dedicated full-time position with Total Plumbing Air Electric.**



The selected candidate must devote their scheduled working hours exclusively to Total Plumbing Air Electric and may not simultaneously work for, provide services to, freelance for, or operate another business during company working hours.



Any outside employment, consulting, freelance work, agency work, or other business activity that could create a conflict of interest, involve a competitor, use company resources, or interfere with the employee's responsibilities must be disclosed and approved by the company in advance.



**We are not looking for an agency, freelancer managing multiple clients, or someone attempting to work multiple jobs during our working hours.**



We are looking for **one dedicated individual who will become responsible for our digital marketing operation.**



## Work Activity & Screen Monitoring Requirement



This position requires the use of company-approved time, activity, and screen-monitoring software during scheduled working hours.



The employee must:



- Keep company-approved screen-sharing or activity-monitoring software active during scheduled working hours.

- Work from the designated company computer or workstation when required.

- Maintain accurate working-time records.

- Remain available and responsive during scheduled working hours.

- Perform company work during paid working time.

- Not disable, manipulate, circumvent, or interfere with authorized monitoring or time-tracking systems.

- Follow all company security, confidentiality, password, and data-protection policies.



Because you will primarily be **working independently**, accountability, communication, time management, and transparency are extremely important.



**Candidates who are uncomfortable working independently or with the company's work-monitoring requirements should not apply.**



## Complete Digital Marketing Responsibilities



You will be responsible for the company's entire digital marketing operation, including:



- Technical SEO

- On-page SEO

- Off-page SEO

- Local SEO

- Google Maps SEO

- Google Business Profile optimization

- Keyword research

- Competitor research

- Backlink acquisition

- Citation building

- NAP consistency

- Service page optimization

- City/location page optimization

- Schema markup

- Internal linking

- Google Search Console

- Google Analytics

- Google Tag Manager

- Core Web Vitals

- Website speed optimization

- WordPress optimization

- Google Ads

- PPC/Search campaigns

- Call-focused advertising campaigns

- Google Local Services Ads

- Meta Ads

-
 Ads

- Instagram Ads

- Retargeting

- Landing page creation and optimization

- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

- Call tracking

- Form tracking

- Lead attribution

- Marketing analytics

- Reporting

- ROI/ROAS analysis



## Google Ads / PPC



You will independently build, manage, monitor, and continuously optimize our paid advertising campaigns.



Responsibilities include campaign structure, keyword research, negative keywords, geographic targeting, bid strategies, ad schedules, conversion tracking, call tracking, landing pages, ad copy, assets, search-term analysis, A/B testing, budget allocation, competitor analysis, and cost-per-lead optimization.



**We are not interested in simply generating clicks.**



Your responsibility is to generate **qualified inbound calls and service opportunities that can become paying customers.**



## SEO, Local SEO & Google Maps



You will be responsible for improving organic and local search visibility for our plumbing, HVAC, electrical, and solar services.



This includes:



- Technical SEO

- On-page SEO

- Off-page SEO

- Local SEO

- Content optimization

- Backlinks

- Citations

- Google Business Profile

- Google Maps rankings

- Service pages

- City/location pages

- Keyword rankings

- Indexing

- Site architecture

- Internal linking

- Schema

- Search Console

- Page speed

- Competitor analysis



## Google Local Services Ads



You will manage our Google Local Services Ads, including budgets, service categories, service areas, lead quality, invalid-lead disputes when appropriate, profile optimization, reviews, call performance, ranking factors, and cost per qualified lead.



## Meta Advertising



You will manage
 and Instagram advertising, including campaign creation, audiences, retargeting, creative testing, ad copy, conversion campaigns, lead-generation campaigns, tracking, attribution, and budget optimization.



## Website & Conversion Optimization



You will continuously improve our website and landing pages to increase lead conversion.



Responsibilities include:



- WordPress management

- Landing page development

- Calls-to-action

- Mobile optimization

- Website speed

- Forms

- Phone-call conversion paths

- Service pages

- Location pages

- User experience

- Analytics

- Conversion tracking

- A/B testing



## Reporting & Accountability



Everything must be measurable.



You will be expected to track and report:



- Qualified inbound calls

- Form submissions

- Booked leads

- Cost per qualified lead

- Cost per acquisition

- Conversion rates

- Google Ads performance

- LSA performance

- SEO rankings

- Google Maps rankings

- Organic traffic

- Meta Ads performance

- Advertising spend

- ROAS

- Marketing-generated revenue



We are looking for someone who focuses on **business results, not vanity metrics.**



## Preferred Experience



Experience marketing the following types of businesses is highly preferred:



- Plumbing

- HVAC

- Electrical

- Solar

- Restoration

- Roofing

- Construction

- Home services

- Local service businesses



## Who We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



- Highly independent

- Self-motivated

- Extremely organized

- Accountable

- Data-driven

- Detail-oriented

- Resourceful

- Comfortable working alone

- Capable of solving problems independently

- Capable of managing multiple marketing channels

- Focused on generating measurable business results

- Able to work without constant supervision



You should constantly be asking:



**How many qualified leads did we generate?**



**What did each qualified lead cost?**



**Which campaigns produced booked jobs?**



**Which keywords generated revenue?**



**Where are we wasting advertising dollars?**



**What can I improve today?**



**How can we generate more qualified business at a lower acquisition cost?**



## How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with examples of digital marketing campaigns you have personally managed.



Your application should include:



1. Google Ads experience and results.

2. SEO and Local SEO experience.

3. Google Maps ranking experience.

4. Google Local Services Ads experience.

5. Meta/Facebook Ads experience.

6. Examples of measurable results.

7. Largest monthly advertising budget you have personally managed.

8. SEO and marketing tools you regularly use.

9. WordPress and website optimization experience.

10. Experience marketing home-service companies.

11. Examples of improvements in cost per lead, rankings, conversion rates, lead volume, or ROAS.

12. Confirmation that you are comfortable working independently without constant supervision.

13. Confirmation that you understand this is a dedicated full-time position.

14. Confirmation that you understand and accept the company's work-monitoring requirements.



## Final Requirement



We are looking for a **long-term, dedicated digital marketing professional who can independently take ownership of Total Plumbing Air Electric's entire digital marketing department.**



You will primarily work independently and will be trusted to determine what needs to be done, execute the work, measure the results, identify problems, and continuously improve performance.



**This is not a position for someone who needs constant direction.**



We want someone who can **build, execute, analyze, optimize, and scale a complete digital marketing system that produces measurable leads and revenue for the company.**

title: Construction Project Coordinator (Australian Modular Homes)
description:
ABOUT US

Elsewhere Pods designs and builds modular homes, studios and tiny homes. Our pods are built in a factory, shipped to Australia, New Zealand and the US, and installed on our customers' properties. We have around 45 projects in delivery at any one time, from permits through to handover.



THE ROLE

You will be the right hand of our Australian Project Manager. He makes the decisions and speaks to the customers. You keep every project moving: chasing, organising, preparing documents and keeping our project system up to date. This is a long-term, full-time role.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Keep our project management system current: tasks, project stages, notes and due dates

- Prepare weekly status updates for each project, for the Project Manager to send to customers

- Collate documents and prepare response packs for building certifiers and councils, and track every request until it is closed

- Send briefs to engineers and designers, chase their returns and check drawings against a checklist

- Request quotes from trades (three quotes per job), onboard new trades and send them scope of works packs

- Keep the install calendar up to date and confirm dates in writing with trades

- Chase the factory and suppliers weekly and track shipments

- Run defect lists, collect compliance certificates and assemble handover packs

- Raise anything urgent (deadlines, safety concerns, unhappy customers) with the Project Manager the same day



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 2+ years as a project coordinator, project administrator or similar in construction, building or trades

- Excellent written and spoken English. You will write to engineers, councils and trades every day

- Highly organised, with strong follow-through. You chase until things are done

- Comfortable learning new software (we use Google Workspace, Slack and our own project system)

- Experience with Australian or New Zealand construction, permits or councils is a big plus

- Reliable fibre internet (25 Mbps or better) and backup power and internet



HOURS

Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:30 PM Melbourne time. That is currently 6:00 AM - 2:30 PM Philippine time (7:00 AM - 3:30 PM from April to October when Australian daylight saving ends).



WHAT WE OFFER

- PHP 55,000 - 80,000 per month, depending on experience, plus 13th month pay

- Long-term, stable full-time work with a growing company

- Work directly with our Australian team. No agency in between



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the words "MODULAR COORDINATOR" so we know you read this ad. Then answer these five questions:

1. Tell us about a construction or building project you coordinated. What was your role?

2. Have you worked with Australian or New Zealand builders, certifiers or councils? If yes, describe it.

3. Can you work 6:00 AM - 2:30 PM Philippine time, Monday to Friday?

4. What backup power and internet do you have? Please attach a screenshot of a speed test (speedtest.net).

5. What monthly salary are you expecting, in PHP?



Please attach your resume. Applications without the five answers will not be considered.
